jobs.title: B2B Cold Caller and Appointment Setter
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team. In this role, you'll introduce our services to marketing executives across the United States, identify potential opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings for our sales team.
Previous cold-calling or B2B sales experience is helpful but not essential. We welcome applications from recent graduates, career changers, and motivated individuals with excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect. Make outbound cold calls to marketing executives and business decision-makers across the United States.
  • Engage. Speak with decision-makers such as Marketing Directors, Marketing Managers, Chief Marketing Officers (CMOs), Digital Marketing Managers, Growth Marketing Managers, Brand Managers, and business owners.
  • Present. Introduce our services in a clear, professional, and conversational manner.
  • Qualify. Build rapport, ask thoughtful qualifying questions, and identify prospective clients who are a good fit for our services.
  • Handle objections. Respond professionally to common questions and objections while maintaining a positive customer experience.
  • Book meetings. Schedule qualified appointments for our sales team and ensure accurate calendar coordination.
  • Maintain records. Keep accurate CRM records, including call outcomes, notes, and follow-up activities.
  • Improve continuously. Participate in call reviews, role-play sessions, and ongoing coaching to strengthen your sales skills.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Excellent communication. Clear spoken English that can be easily understood by customers in the United States.
  • Confidence. Comfortable speaking with senior business decision-makers over the phone.
  • Active listening. Able to ask insightful questions and understand customer needs.
  • Coachability. Welcomes feedback and applies it to improve performance.
  • Resilience. Maintains a positive attitude and persistence when facing rejection.
  • Curiosity. Enjoys learning about businesses and uncovering opportunities through conversation.
  • Organisation. Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately maintain CRM records and follow-up activities.
  • Fast learner. Quickly understands new products, services, and sales techniques.
  • Professionalism. Represents the company with confidence and integrity in every interaction.
  • Natural communication. Able to follow a structured sales process while sounding authentic and conversational, rather than reading mechanically from a script.
Nice to Have
  • Experience. Previous experience in marketing, cold calling, telesales, appointment setting, customer service, or B2B sales is preferred but not required. We believe communication skills, coachability, and a willingness to learn are stronger predictors of success than experience alone.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive training. Learn our products, services, and proven outbound sales process.
  • Ongoing coaching. Receive regular feedback, call reviews, and mentoring to help you succeed.
  • Career development. Build highly transferable communication, negotiation, and business development skills.
  • Remote flexibility. Work remotely with a supportive team.
  • Competitive pay. Earn USD $4–$8 per hour, depending on relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated sales ability, and overall fit for the role. Bonuses are available for strong performance, including qualified meetings successfully booked.
  • Growth opportunities. This role has the potential to become an ongoing position for the right candidate, with opportunities for growth as you develop your skills and contribute to the team's success.

jobs.title: (Senior) AI Strategy & Implementation Consultant
jobs.excerpt: Neurawork sucht den Consultant, der unsere Kunden durch die KI-Transformation führt — von der Strategie bis zur Implementierung.
jobs.description:
Neurawork sucht den Consultant, der unsere Kunden durch die KI-Transformation führt — von der Strategie bis zur Implementierung.

Du willst in der KI-Implementierung im Mittelstand arbeiten — aber ohne 50-Folien-Decks zu bauen oder Luftschloss-Ideen umzusetzen, die beim Kunden nie ankommen. Du hast KI nicht nur in einem Wochenend-Zertifikatskurs gelernt, sondern selbst gebaut, integriert und zum Laufen gebracht — und willst dieses Können jetzt strategisch einsetzen, nicht nur operativ. Du willst echte Transformation begleiten, nach klaren Strukturen, mit messbarem Ergebnis.

Dann arbeite bei uns als Consultant in der KI-Transformation unserer Mittelstandskunden. Wir arbeiten nach unserem eigenen Operational-AI-Vorgehensmodell, implementieren klare Strukturen beim Kunden über standardisierte Produkte und führen ihn durch die gesamte Transformation. Wir sind keine Automation-Agentur und keine Custom-Softwareentwickler. Wir kreieren echten, messbaren Mehrwert — und stehen dafür ein.

Wenn das dein Calling ist, lies weiter:

Aufgaben

Was du bei uns machst

  • Mandatsverantwortung in KI-Strategie- und Implementierungsprojekten beim Mittelstand (Branchenschwerpunkte u.a. Dienstleistungen und Investoren)
  • Strategiearbeit horizontal über alle Funktionsbereiche — Marketing, Vertrieb, Kundenbetreuung, Buchhaltung, Operations, IT
  • Use-Case-Priorisierung und Roadmap-Design nach Wirkung
  • Change Management begleitet jedes Mandat mit — du sorgst dafür, dass die Umsetzung den Faktor Mensch berücksichtigt und Veränderungen proaktiv adressiert werden
  • Technischer Support und enge Abstimmung mit der IT-Abteilung des Kunden während der Implementierung
  • Wissenstransfer in unsere TÜV-SÜD-zertifizierte KI-Ausbildung und ins KI-Business-Coaching — Live-Sessions aus laufenden Projekten

Wie wir arbeiten

  • Framework-driven, nicht ad-hoc. Wer Methodik schätzt, statt jedes Mal neu zu erfinden, ist hier richtig. Hierbei kannst du selbst die Frameworks mitgestalten
  • Standardprodukte liefern den Hebel — Custom-Entwicklung gibt es bei uns nicht. Anpassungen zur Full-Integration beim Kunden sind selbstverständlich
  • Wert statt Stunden. Wir verkaufen Ergebnisse, keine Tagessätze
  • Direkter Draht zum Founding-Team, keine Beratungspyramide
  • Wir zeigen Präsenz und übernehmen Verantwortung — online wie offline. Unser Geschäftsführer Christoph Knöll ist mit klarer Haltung sichtbar in der DACH-KI-Szene (data:unplugged, TÜV SÜD, LinkedIn). Du arbeitest in einem Team, das Position bezieht

Qualifikation

Was wir suchen

  • Du hast KI-Systeme selbst konzipiert und gebaut, nicht nur genutzt oder begleitet — eine RAG-Pipeline aufgesetzt, einen Agenten produktiv gebracht, eine Automatisierung technisch verantwortet — und kannst dein technisches Verständnis (LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Cloud- vs. Lokalbetrieb, deren jeweilige Grenzen) im Fachgespräch an genau diesem Projekt verteidigen
  • Du hast 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung mit nachweisbarer Mandats- oder Projektverantwortung — als Strategie-, Management- oder Technologieconsultant, als (Teil-)Projektleiter:in einer KI- oder Digitalisierungsinitiative, oder in vergleichbarer operativer Verantwortung. Der Titel ist uns egal, die Verantwortung nicht
  • Du weist eine souveräne Kundenführung sowohl auf C-Level als auch auf Projektleiter-Ebene auf
  • Was uns nicht überzeugt: eine Weiterbildung zum "KI-Berater" ohne technische Substanz dahinter. Wenn dein KI-Wissen auf einem Zertifikatskurs statt auf eigener Umsetzung beruht, passen wir aktuell leider nicht zusammen
  • Du hast idealerweise erste Erfahrung in der Präsentation und Wissensvermittlung vor Gruppen — Live-Sessions im KI-Business-Coaching, Online-Events, Workshops mit vielen Teilnehmenden
  • Du bringst ein verhandlungssicheres Deutsch sowie gutes Englisch mit
  • Du hast einen Wohnsitz in Deutschland

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Mandatsverantwortung ab dem ersten Projekt, ohne Layer über dir
  • Fachlicher Austausch mit der KI-Elite in Deutschland - in unserem Team bist du immer am Zahn der Zeit
  • Moderner Tech-Stack und Raum zur Vertestung
  • Sichtbarkeit als Experte über unsere KI-Business-Coaching-Community und TÜV-SÜD-Kooperation
  • Voll-remote möglich— Teamtage und Kundenworkshops vor Ort, üblicherweise 2-4 Tage/Monat im DACH-Raum
  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Marktgerechtes Gehalt bei schnellen Wachstumsmöglichkeiten

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung — am meisten aber auf das Projekt, das du uns zeigen willst!

jobs.title: Customer Success Advisor
jobs.excerpt: The companySmall businesses move fast.  Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight.
jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Customer Success Advisor

At iwoca, we value every customer and want them to have the best possible experience. Customer Success Advisors are at the heart of our Customer Success team, serving customers at all stages of their journey. Upon joining you’ll immediately become a key member of a highly motivated and energetic team.

The team

The Customer Success team are one of the main engine rooms of the business. They provide a quick, informative and dedicated service to iwoca's current and future customers. They are at the front line of all queries ensuring requests are met with a professional response.

This is a Leeds based team which continues to grow weekly providing incredible development opportunities in a supportive environment!

Want to get a deeper understanding of what life is like on the team? Read this blog from our Customer Success Mentor Conor.

The role

Your main responsibility will be delivering a positive customer journey. You’ll be engaging with business owners in a friendly manner and handle each query with expert care and efficiency. You'll be tasked with using your sales ability to convert inbound prospects and educating them on our services to meet their needs.

A typical day can include answering inbound calls to our main line, answering queries and requests as well as handling web chats and customer emails and helping businesses to complete their loan applications.

The requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Ideally you'll have:

  • A passion for delighting customers and a real enthusiasm for helping SMEs. You’ll need to be able to build rapport with business owners quickly

  • Great time management and multitasking skills to be able to adapt to our customer’s needs

  • To be a self-starter taking ownership of your customers, whilst collaborating with your team to reach group targets

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a professional manner

  • The ability to "think outside the box" and have the confidence to put forward ideas, often to other departments, to help us improve our processes

  • To be able to adapt to the growth of an ambitious company. You’ll take new products, customers groups and processes in your stride

  • We welcome people who are proactive, motivated and metrics-driven who have an ambitious and entrepreneurial spirit.

The salary

Our base salary range in Leeds is £28,000 - £29,000. We want to pay all of our employees fairly, so that’s why we regularly benchmark salaries based on market rates and to recognise your increasing value to our business.

For your first month in the role during training, there is a requirement to be in the office four times per week. This will then drop to once or twice per week upon completion of training. This is a Monday - Friday role working from 9 am to 6 pm.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation Range: £28K - £29K

Why SOCOTEC?

Build a traditional career path or explore opportunities across multiple disciplines - all within SOCOTEC. Your choice, your direction.

Work Your Way

Local, national, or global projects. Office-based, remote, or hybrid. We offer the flexibility that empowers you to perform at your best.

We are committed to acting as a key player in society, investing in innovative solutions to ensure social and environmental concerns are at the forefront of all of our business operations.

We offer a comprehensive range of services including building surveying, project management, dilapidations advice, technical due diligence, compliance support, and sustainability consultancy. Our specialists focus on delivering solutions that are not only technically robust but also commercially sensible. By prioritising quality, reliability, and strong client relationships, we ensure buildings are safe, efficient, and future-ready — creating spaces that perform better for businesses, communities, and the environment.

Your expertise deserves recognition. jobs.description:
Conetic is an innovative global company dedicated to transforming the flying experience by making the passenger journey engaging and truly memorable.

We specialize in comprehensive media services, with a focus on creating more personalized and engaging experiences for travelers at every step of the journey.

By uniting Touch Inflight Solutions and ABOVE, Conetic brings together a leading IFE content service provider and a robust cloud-based media distribution platform. This combination of curated content, data-driven personalization, and an automated cloud media supply chain enables airlines to deliver fresh, personalized content to passengers faster and more efficiently through a seamless, end-to-end solution.

ABOVE has a strong competitive edge with a highly qualified team with a unique combination of IFE and digital video services, a technology head start with a proven platform and the size, speed and flexibility that allows for a no-frills service focus and quick adaptation to customer needs.

About the role:

We are looking for an experienced Media Asset Analyst to join our team. You will be responsible for daily operational activities by interacting with the different internal and external stakeholders, while keeping the customer’s satisfaction as the top priority. In this role, you’ll be part of an international team that’s responsible for the full software development life cycle, from conception to deployment for the ABOVE platform. ABOVE provides a standards-based platform, storing and distributing encoded video and related metadata. The ABOVE platform is a cloud-based web application with AWS which is built for our customers such as well-known Airlines.

If you have excellent time management and organizational skills, as well as a problem-solving mindset, we would like to meet you.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform validation of content sets and individual files, which includes validating technical compliance, audio/video sync issues, language verification, aspect ratios and image & metadata correctness;

  • Confirm proper display / playback of content on a variety of system mock-ups to ensure consistency, integrity, and quality;

  • Coordinate quick and effective re-working of rejected media and follow problems through to their resolution;

  • Utilize experience/knowledge gained to identify trends and issues, improve quality and efficiency, and recommend alternatives;

  • Keep accurate and detailed records of all actions taken on test/validation and issue resolutions;

  • Track and monitor all tasks within the process for each client request.

About you:

  • Be familiar with a variety of GUI display and navigation requirements to ensure proper presentation of representative images and metadata;

  • Have in-depth understanding of assigned customer profiles, content requirements and viewing restrictions;

  • Have strong judgement capabilities to identify / report content which may not be fitting for specific client(s);

jobs.excerpt: About UnconventionalSince 2022, AI has entered the mainstream, reshaping entire industries from education and software development to fundamental consumer behaviors.
jobs.description:
About Unconventional

Since 2022, AI has entered the mainstream, reshaping entire industries from education and software development to fundamental consumer behaviors. This revolution has created an unprecedented demand for computation - a demand that is now fundamentally limited by energy, not just in the datacenter, but at a global scale.

At Unconventional, our mission is to solve this. We are rethinking computing from the ground up to build a new foundation for AI that is 1000x more efficient. We're doing this by exploiting the rich physics of semiconductors, mapping neural networks directly to the device physics rather than relying on layers of inefficient abstraction.

The Role

As a Member of Technical Staff, Language & Reasoning Models, you will drive the development of foundational language and reasoning models that fundamentally leverage the dynamics of our novel silicon. Your goal is to map the behaviors of modern language models directly onto the physics of our hardware.

You will sit at the intersection of NLP/reasoning research and hardware codesign, proving that high-fidelity, large-scale language understanding and generation can be achieved natively on an unconventional computing substrate.

What You'll Do

  • Model Development: Design, train, and scale next-generation language and reasoning architectures (such as transformers, state space models, diffusion/flow models, and deep equilibrium models) specifically tailored for unconventional compute.
  • Physics-Informed Architecture: Rethink standard sequence modeling to exploit the continuous-time dynamics of silicon, moving away from layers of inefficient digital abstraction.
  • Evaluation & Scaling: Establish the training recipes, loss functions, and evaluation metrics needed to reach the frontier of language comprehension, logical reasoning, and generation speed while maintaining the massive energy efficiency of our platform.
  • Extreme Codesign: Collaborate with hardware designers and theorists, and system builders to co-design the model architecture alongside the underlying physical compute primitives.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: An MS/PhD or equivalent research/project experience in a quantitative field such as AI/Machine Learning, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or Applied Math.
  • Experience: Deep, hands-on expertise in the theory, architecture, and training of modern foundation models (transformers, SSMs, text diffusion/flow, etc.).
  • Systems Fluency: Hands-on, battle-tested experience dealing with model scaling. You have successfully designed and executed full-scale, distributed training runs for large language or reasoning models, managing the complexities of massive compute clusters.
  • Software Development: You are fluent in modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or JAX) and have a proven track record of writing clean, scalable training code for large language models.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

  • Unconventional Experience: As a bonus, you may have experience working with hardware-in-the-loop training, mixed-signal hardware, quantization, or physics-informed neural networks

.

Why Join Us?

  • The Mission: Redefine computing for the next 50 years by solving the fundamental energy limitation of AI at a global scale.
  • The Impact: Shape the company's future as a foundational team member. Enjoy massive ownership and an outsized opportunity to drive change.
  • The Perks: A comprehensive package including best-in-class health benefits, 401k matching, truly unlimited PTO, and complimentary meals in our Palo Alto office.

jobs.description:
(Version en français plus bas)

About the Role

Invisible Colors is looking for a Freelance Brand Art Director to help shape distinctive visual identities and creative worlds for brands, campaigns, and experiences.

We’re looking for someone who can take a strategic idea and turn it into a strong visual point of view — from the initial concept and moodboards through to the development of complete brand systems and creative executions.

You have a strong understanding of branding and visual culture, but you’re not interested in following formulas. You know how to build visual languages that feel intentional, contemporary, and ownable, and you’re equally comfortable thinking big-picture or obsessing over the smallest detail.

This is a freelance opportunity with the potential to collaborate across a variety of projects, industries, and creative formats.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop creative direction and visual concepts for new and evolving brands.
  • Create and evolve brand identities, visual languages, and design systems.
  • Translate brand strategy and positioning into compelling visual concepts.
  • Develop moodboards, creative territories, visual references, and presentation decks.
  • Establish art direction across typography, color, composition, imagery, illustration, motion, and other visual elements.
  • Extend brand identities across digital, social, web, campaigns, print, physical environments, and experiential activations.
  • Provide clear creative direction to designers, photographers, videographers, animators, and other creative partners.
  • Collaborate with strategists, copywriters, designers, producers, and clients to develop ideas from concept through execution.
  • Present and articulate creative concepts clearly, explaining the thinking behind the work.
  • Ensure creative consistency and quality across multiple touchpoints and deliverables.
  • Push concepts beyond the expected and identify opportunities to make the work more distinctive, culturally relevant, and memorable.
  • Stay curious about emerging visual trends, technology, culture, AI, design, photography, fashion, music, and other influences that can inform creative work.
  • Participate in creative brainstorms and contribute ideas beyond your immediate area of expertise.
  • Adapt quickly between different brands, industries, creative challenges, and visual styles.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience as an Art Director, Brand Art Director, Senior Designer, or similar creative role.
  • Strong experience developing or evolving brand identities and visual systems.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong art direction, branding, conceptual thinking, and visual storytelling.
  • Excellent understanding of typography, composition, color, imagery, layout, and visual hierarchy.
  • Strong conceptual and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect creative ideas back to a brand’s objectives.
  • Ability to develop a distinctive visual point of view while working within a broader brand strategy.
  • Experience taking creative concepts from early exploration through to final execution.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills.
  • Ability to give thoughtful, constructive creative direction and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Comfortable working independently and managing multiple creative projects or priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger creative idea.
  • Curiosity and openness to experimentation, new technologies, and emerging creative tools.
  • Experience working within a creative agency, branding studio, production company, or similarly fast-paced creative environment is an asset.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with integrated campaigns and experiential / physical brand activations.
  • Experience directing photography, video, motion, or other visual production.
  • Strong understanding of digital and social-first creative.
  • Experience working with emerging technologies, AI tools, or generative design workflows.
  • Experience working with lifestyle, technology, fashion, beauty, entertainment, hospitality, or consumer brands.
  • Ability to move between high-level creative direction and hands-on design when needed.

How You Work

We’re less interested in titles and credentials than in how you think and what you make.

You’re someone who:

  • Has a strong visual point of view.
  • Can explain why an idea works, not just what it looks like.
  • Knows when to follow the brief — and when to challenge it.
  • Is comfortable with ambiguity and figuring things out along the way.
  • Can work collaboratively without losing your creative voice.
  • Cares about the details that make good work feel exceptional.
  • Brings curiosity, taste, and energy to the creative process.

What We Offer

  • Freelance, project-based collaboration.
  • Opportunity to work across a diverse range of brands, industries, and creative challenges.
  • Collaboration with a multidisciplinary creative team across branding, strategy, digital, content, production, and emerging technology.
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to work spanning brand identity, campaigns, digital experiences, and experiential projects.
  • Potential for ongoing collaboration based on project needs and fit.

Portfolio

Your portfolio is the most important part of your application.

Please share a portfolio that demonstrates your approach to brand thinking, art direction, visual identity, and creative problem-solving.

We’re interested in seeing the thinking behind the work, not just polished final visuals.

À propos du rôle

Invisible Colors est à la recherche d’un(e) directeur(trice) artistique de marque freelance pour contribuer à créer des identités visuelles distinctives et des univers créatifs pour des marques, des campagnes et des expériences.

  • Développer des moodboards, territoires créatifs, références visuelles et présentations.

  • Décliner les identités de marque sur différents supports : numérique, médias sociaux, sites web, campagnes, imprimés, environnements physiques et activations expérientielles.
  • Donner une direction créative claire aux designers, photographes, vidéastes, animateurs et autres partenaires créatifs.
  • Collaborer avec les stratèges, rédacteurs, designers, producteurs et clients pour développer les idées, du concept à l’exécution.

  • Excellente compréhension de la typographie, de la composition, des couleurs, de l’imagerie, de la mise en page et de la hiérarchie visuelle.

  • Capacité à développer une vision visuelle distinctive tout en respectant une stratégie de marque plus large.
  • Expérience dans le développement de concepts créatifs, de l’exploration initiale jusqu’à l’exécution finale.

Votre façon de travailler

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

About the Role

We are looking for a Regional Payroll Specialist to own and coordinate payroll operations across BJAK Group and its businesses, supporting employees across multiple countries and employment structures.

This is a hands-on role responsible for making sure employees are paid accurately and on time, payroll inputs are properly controlled, and statutory requirements are met. You will work across internal HR and Finance teams, local payroll providers and Employer of Record (EOR) partners to manage payroll from input collection through reconciliation and completion.

The role is suited to someone who is highly detail-oriented, comfortable working across different countries and able to build reliable payroll processes as the organisation scales.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Managing monthly payroll cycles across multiple countries, entities and employment arrangements.

  • Preparing and validating payroll inputs including salaries, new hires, terminations, bonuses, allowances, deductions, unpaid leave and other employee changes.

  • Reviewing payroll calculations and reports before approval to ensure accuracy and identify discrepancies.

  • Coordinating with local payroll vendors, EOR partners and internal teams to ensure payroll is completed accurately and on schedule.

  • Managing statutory payroll requirements including taxes, social contributions, pension or other mandatory contributions across different jurisdictions.

  • Handling payroll-related employee queries and resolving discrepancies quickly and accurately.

  • Supporting employee onboarding and offboarding from a payroll perspective, including final pay calculations and required documentation.

  • Reconciling payroll outputs against HR records, approved compensation changes and Finance records.

  • Maintaining accurate payroll documentation, records, approvals and audit trails.

  • Building and improving payroll SOPs, controls, calendars and reporting as the group expands into new markets.

  • Supporting the implementation and ongoing administration of payroll and HR systems.

  • Working closely with HR, Finance, Legal and external partners on payroll compliance, audits and operational issues.

What You'll Need

  • 3+ years of hands-on payroll experience, ideally supporting employees across multiple countries or entities.

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll operations, including payroll inputs, calculations, reconciliation and statutory requirements.

  • Experience working with external payroll providers and/or EOR partners.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately with sensitive employee and compensation data.

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, with confidence handling payroll data and reconciliations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting payroll across Asia, Europe, the UK and/or US.

  • Experience in a fast-growing technology company or international startup.

  • Experience implementing or migrating payroll/HRIS systems.

  • Familiarity with multi-entity payroll, EOR arrangements and distributed teams.

  • Experience supporting payroll audits, statutory reporting or payroll accounting.

What Success Looks Like

Payroll runs accurately and on time across every market you support. Employee changes are reflected correctly, discrepancies are caught before payment, vendors are managed closely, and HR and Finance have clear, reliable payroll records.

As the group grows, you will help turn country-by-country payroll processes into a scalable and well-controlled operating model.

jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Direct Acquisition team at iwoca is responsible for acquiring customers profitably across paid and organic channels. Paid Social is one of our highest-growth channels; we've validated the opportunity, proven incrementality, and scaled from test budgets to six-figure monthly spend across Meta and TikTok. Now we need to build on those foundations and scale toward a 3x growth ambition across a multi-product offering that includes both flexi-loans and credit cards.

You'll join a team that:

  • Takes measurement seriously: We run conversion lift studies, work closely with data science on attribution, and make budget decisions based on predicted and incremental ROI, not vanity metrics.

  • Cares deeply about creative: We believe the ad is the targeting, and we're building a creative engine that spans creator partnerships, UGC, and AI-assisted production.

  • Is genuinely AI-native: We use AI tools daily for analysis, creative development, and workflow automation, and we expect you to do the same.

The role

Paid Social at iwoca is working; we've proven the channel's incremental value, scaled to six-figure monthly spend, and built the measurement infrastructure to back it up. But there's a lot more to go after with a credit card to bring to market, a creative engine to build, and a lot of room still to scale. The remit is broad - you'll scale the channel, bring our credit card to market and grow it aggressively alongside our core lending product. You'll invest heavily in creative - particularly video and influencer marketing - building ads that actually cut through in a category where most ads look the same.

Key responsibilities include:

Strategy & Campaign Architecture

  • Own Paid Social as a channel: set the vision, define the road map, allocate budget, and report on performance to leadership.

  • Bring our credit card product to market through paid social: build the campaign strategy, creative approach, and measurement framework for a major product launch.

  • Architect full-funnel structures across Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn - awareness, prospecting, lead capture, re-targeting, and conversion - with clear success metrics, audience hand-offs, and frequency management at each stage.

  • Manage multi-product overlap: flexi-loans, credit cards, and other products share audiences but serve different customer needs.

  • Expand audience reach through content-led lead capture campaigns targeting out-of-market prospects to fuel top-of-funnel growth.

  • Scale into new platforms where there's genuine opportunity; we’ve validated a significant opportunity on TikTok, but other platforms such as Linkedin and Youtube Shorts remain largely untapped.

Creative Strategy & Production

  • Develop creative that actually stands out: paid social in financial services is full of generic stock imagery and safe messaging. We want you to push beyond that, finding the concepts, formats, and creators that people actually notice.

  • Make a significant investment in video and influencer marketing: build relationships with creators who can speak authentically about business finance, and develop a pipeline that delivers volume without it becoming generic.

  • Build a testing framework that connects creative concepts to commercial outcomes

  • Partner with the Brand team to make sure performance and brand creative reinforce each other rather than pulling in different directions.

Measurement & Incrementality

  • Design, run, and turn conversion lift studies and geo-lift tests into investment cases that prove incremental value and justify budget expansion.

  • Partner with Data Science and the Acquitech team on attribution methodology, event architecture, and multi-step conversion tracking.

  • Extend testing beyond ad platforms to landing page experiments and signup flow improvements to reduce drop-off between click and conversion.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage and develop a Performance Marketing Executive, coaching them on strategic thinking and commercial analysis while delegating clear operational ownership.

  • Partner with Data Science, Engineering, Compliance, and Brand teams, while getting genuine strategic value from Meta and TikTok platform reps.

The requirements

  • Mechanically curious: You understand why platforms work the way they do, stay updated on algorithmic changes, and have an industry network for shared learning.

  • High-initiative: You define experiments, draft business cases, and drive projects forward without waiting for explicit briefs.

  • Analytically self-sufficient: You pull your own data, build your own performance views, and think in terms of CLTV, ROI, and marginal returns.

  • AI-native: You already use AI tools meaningfully in your work - whether for creative analysis, reporting, workflow automation, or something we haven't thought of.

  • Commercially minded: You care about profitable customer acquisition and lifetime value.

What You Bring:

  • Proven track record of scaling paid social budgets based on measured commercial performance.

  • Deep campaign architecture expertise on Meta (bidding strategies, audience signals, and creative interaction).

  • Experience with multi-product, multi-market and value-based bidding models.

  • Strategic creative capability connecting concepts to commercial hypotheses.

Nice to Have:

  • B2B paid social experience (or strong analytical background in B2C).

  • Experience managing or coaching junior team members.

  • Fluency in measurement and incrementality (conversion lift studies, holdout methodologies, and incremental value).

  • Hands-on experience with TikTok advertising at scale.

  • Fintech or financial services background.

The compensation

£70,000 - £90,000 (bench marked regularly with quarterly performance reviews).

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

The Associate Project Manager is a member of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE), responsible for managing operational and process improvement projects while supporting larger cross-functional initiatives. This role partners with business stakeholders and project sponsors to plan, coordinate, execute, and implement projects that drive operational effectiveness and business outcomes.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized and results-oriented project professional who can independently manage projects, coordinate activities across multiple stakeholders, and contribute to larger cross-functional initiatives. This individual combines strong project management fundamentals with a hands-on approach to execution and continuous improvement.

Serving as a key point of coordination across Operations and cross-functional teams, this role helps drive project success through effective planning, communication, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Independently manage small to medium-sized operational, process improvement, and business projects from identification through implementation.
  • Support the senior manager and business leaders on larger, more complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, and project artifacts.
  • Define project scope, deliverables, schedules, and success measures for assigned projects.
  • Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, issues, dependencies, and potential roadblocks.
  • Coordinate resources and stakeholders to ensure projects remain on track and objectives are achieved.
  • Facilitate problem resolution and escalate significant risks or issues when appropriate.
  • Support implementation activities and help ensure successful transition and adoption of project outcomes.
  • Maintain accountability for project deliverables, timelines, and commitments.

Execution & Project Support

  • Actively contributes to project execution activities to achieve business objectives and ensure successful delivery.
  • Prepare project deliverables, documentation, communications, presentations, enablement materials, and implementation plans.
  • Support teams in identifying and resolving operational challenges that may impact project scope, timelines, or business outcomes.
  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure action items are completed, decisions are documented, and commitments are fulfilled.
  • Apply a hands-on approach to delivery, helping teams translate plans into action and move initiatives efficiently from planning through execution.
  • Leverage AI, automation, and digital tools to streamline project processes, improve efficiency, and enhance delivery outcomes.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong relationships across the organization to drive alignment, engagement, and execution.
  • Coordinate project activities across Operations, Product, IT, Finance, Sales, and other business functions.
  • Facilitate project meetings, working sessions, and stakeholder communications; support leadership reviews as needed.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned projects and initiatives.
  • Communicate project status, key decisions, risks, dependencies, and priorities to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders at all levels to support project objectives, resolve issues, and drive successful outcomes.

Portfolio Management & Reporting

  • Manage multiple assigned projects simultaneously while balancing priorities, timelines, and stakeholder needs.
  • Prepare and maintain project status reports, project metrics, and support documentation.
  • Monitor project progress and identify risks, issues, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Follow established Procurement CoE project management standards, processes, and tools.
  • Provide project stakeholders and leadership with regular updates regarding milestones, timelines, and key deliverables.
  • Support resource coordination and project planning activities for assigned initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate project records, documentation, and action logs to support successful project execution.

Enablement, Continuous Improvement & Communication

  • Develop and maintain project templates, playbooks, standard work, and proven practices to drive consistency and execution excellence.
  • Partner with stakeholders to support communications, readiness activities, enablement, and adoption efforts.
  • Ensure stakeholders understand project objectives, timelines, impacts, decisions, and required actions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve project delivery and operational effectiveness through process optimization, automation, and digital solutions.
  • Utilize data, reporting, and AI-enabled tools to support project planning, performance monitoring, and informed decision-making.
  • Support and promote innovative ways of working that improve productivity, collaboration, and business outcomes.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, sharing, and implementing lessons learned across projects and initiatives.

KEY SKILLS –The ideal candidate for this role will excel in the following areas.

  • Execution Excellence – Drives disciplined execution, manages priorities and dependencies, and consistently delivers results.
  • Ownership & Accountability – Takes ownership of assigned projects and deliverables, proactively addresses challenges, and follows through to completion.
  • Project Management – Effectively plans, coordinates, and manages multiple initiatives, timelines, resources, risks, and dependencies.
  • Organization & Prioritization – Maintains structure across multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration – Builds trusted relationships, aligns diverse stakeholders, and drives cross-functional outcomes.
  • Change Management & Adoption – Supports organizational change by facilitating stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness activities, training, and adoption of new processes, tools, and ways of working.
  • Communication – Communicates priorities, risks, decisions, and recommendations clearly, concisely, and professionally.
  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – Proactively identifies issues, evaluates potential impacts, and develops practical solutions to maintain project momentum.
  • Adaptability & Agility – Responds effectively to changing priorities, business needs, and project requirements while maintaining focus on results.
  • Continuous Improvement – Identifies opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and enhance project delivery through standardization, automation, and best practices.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of experience in project management, project coordination, PMO, business operations, or a related field.
  • Experience leading small projects independently and supporting medium to large cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage project schedules, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and supporting projects through planning, execution, implementation, and adoption.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with project management and work management tools (Smartsheet preferred).
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Experience supporting process improvement or change management initiatives preferred.
  • CAPM, project management coursework, Lean Six Sigma, or change management training preferred.
  • Experience utilizing AI-enabled productivity tools to improve efficiency and project execution preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to occasionally travel for workshops or meetings.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

Gordian is the world’s leading provider of facility and construction cost data, software and services for all phases of the building lifecycle. jobs.description:
About MDOTM

MDOTM is a global leading provider of AI-driven investment solutions, growing across our offices in London, Milan, and New York. We recently closed a $27M growth equity round, led by Expedition Growth Capital, to support our continued international expansion. Our proprietary platform, Sphere, currently supports over $100B in assets under management for institutional clients including Morgan Stanley, Amundi, and Zurich Bank.

Role Overview

MDOTM, a leading provider of AI-driven investment solutions, is looking for an Intermediate DevOps Engineer to join our Platform Team. You will play a key role in supporting, enhancing, and maintaining the foundational infrastructure and tools that empower our product teams — contributing to a reliable, scalable, and efficient developer platform that enables fast and secure software delivery for Sphere, our proprietary AI-driven investment platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and automation of CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD) to ensure fast, safe, and repeatable releases across all environments.
  • Assist in the adoption and management of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Ansible, helping provision and manage on-premise and AWS resources in a controlled, auditable, and reproducible manner.
  • Work with Docker and Kubernetes to package and operate services, contributing to declarative configuration, GitOps practices, and efficient resource utilization.
  • Help implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Zabbix), and participate in on-call rotations to ensure high availability and low Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR).
  • Contribute to embedding security best practices (OWASP Top 10, least privilege IAM, shift-left testing) into the SDLC and help automate security controls within pipelines.
  • Support the management and automation of database infrastructure (MySQL, MongoDB), including provisioning, backups, and automated schema migrations.
  • Automate and support the deployment, scaling, and operational health of core platform services (authentication, data pipelines, messaging) for internal consumers.
  • Participate in technical design discussions, learn from architectural decisions related to infrastructure and operations, and help document runbooks and standards.
  • Champion DevOps culture ("you build it, you run it") and share knowledge through demos, pair programming, and internal workshops.

Skills Required

  • 1–3 years of professional experience in a DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) role, with a focus on automation, infrastructure, and CI/CD
  • Hands-on experience working with and contributing to CI/CD pipelines
  • Practical experience with Docker and exposure to Kubernetes, including writing Dockerfiles and debugging containerized applications
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible
  • Experience with at least one monitoring, logging, or alerting system (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Zabbix), and curiosity for SRE principles
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash) for automating common tasks
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in the SDLC
  • Good analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting system and infrastructure issues
  • Clear English communication, collaborative spirit, and a growth mindset aligned with a culture of shared ownership and rapid feedback

Bonus points:

  • Experience with event-driven systems (e.g., ActiveMQ)
  • Contributions to open-source projects
  • Familiarity with backend development concepts (e.g., Java/Spring Boot)
  • Working knowledge of AWS fundamentals (EC2, S3, IAM)
  • Financial-services or high-throughput data processing background

Why Join Us?

  • Work at the leading edge of technology, leveraging our decade of experience in proprietary AI to power a platform trusted by top-tier institutional clients.
  • Truly flexible work environment — we care about output, not hours logged.
  • Collaborate daily with an ultra-international team (18+ nationalities) across our Milan, London, and New York offices.
  • Annual company retreat at a stunning location, because we invest in our people beyond the day job.
  • Real, fast-track career progression, with outsized growth opportunities for early team members.

Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62K-80K/yr

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

· Work-Life Balance

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Arizona is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and/or Colorado preferred.

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.

  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!
