jobs.excerpt: About SafeLeaseAt SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change.
jobs.description:
About SafeLease

At SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.

SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both. We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.

We're a team of 85, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.

Why "Builder"?

The best people on our team start with a business problem, figure out what should exist to solve it, and then build it, often end-to-end. They talk to stakeholders, sketch out solutions, make product and design decisions, write the code, and ship it. They use AI tools not as a novelty but as a core part of how they work. The line between "product thinking" and "engineering" isn't one they spend much time drawing.

We call this role Builder because that's what it actually is. You'll work in small pods with a GM who sets direction, but how you get there and what you build along the way is largely up to you.

If you're looking for a well-defined backlog and a narrow lane, this probably isn't the right fit. If you want the autonomy to solve real problems and the context to understand why they matter, keep reading.

About the Role

To drive our mission forward, this role will:

  • Start with the problem, not the ticket. Understand the business context behind what you're building. Know why it matters to customers, to the business, and to the team.

  • Own outcomes, not just output. Take features from idea to production. That means participating in product and design decisions, not waiting for a spec to land in your lap.

  • Build across the full stack. Write clean, maintainable code across frontend, backend, and infrastructure with a focus on reliability, performance, and simplicity.

  • Use AI as a force multiplier. Leverage AI-powered tools to move faster, explore solutions more broadly, and spend your time on the problems that actually require human judgment.

  • Improve the system, not just your code. Identify opportunities to make the platform better, the team faster, and the product sharper. Bring ideas, not just implementations.

  • Collaborate with high context. Work closely with your pod, leadership, and cross-functional partners. Share what you know, ask what you don't.

About You

You're a problem solver who happens to write code, not the other way around. You care about what gets built as much as how it gets built. You're comfortable with ambiguity, energized by ownership, and sharp enough to develop a working understanding of the business you're building for.

Your experience:

  • 2-5+ years of experience in full-stack software development with a track record of shipping real-world applications

  • Background in CS/EE, a coding bootcamp, or equivalent hands-on experience building production systems

  • Proficiency across Frontend (TypeScript, JavaScript, React), Backend (Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs), and Infrastructure (relational databases, Git, AWS)

  • Demonstrated fluency with AI-powered development tools (Cursor, Claude, Copilot, etc.) — not just awareness, but active use in your workflow

  • Ability to think beyond code: you consider the user, the business case, and the tradeoffs, not just the implementation

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset — you ask good questions, give direct feedback, and make the people around you better

  • DevOps experience is a plus — understanding how your code runs in production matters here

  • Excited to work in-person or hybrid from our downtown Austin office

Why SafeLease?

The tech: Our prospects convert fast because we’re solving real problems and delivering serious value to commercial real estate owners.

The team: We’re a team of seasoned pros and sharp operators who know how to move fast and build smart. High standards, low ego.

The stability: We’re well-funded, growing fast, and we make sure our team shares in that success with competitive pay and equity.

The employee experience: We also offer unlimited PTO, full health benefits, flexible work setups, and the kind of culture where people want to show up to do their best work.


If you don't have all the qualifications listed, don't worry! We understand everyone's career path is unique and still encourage you to apply if you feel this role is aligned with your career trajectory.

Employment at SafeLease is contingent upon a satisfactory verification of a general and criminal background check.

The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.

  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month

jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop a theologically grounded, highly visual book exploring sacred art—past or present—that helps readers engage both its beauty and its theological depth. This project should integrate compelling visuals with thoughtful, accessible commentary that invites reflection, worship, and deeper understanding. It could take the form of a trade book, coffee table book, or something else. The strongest proposals will clearly define the reader and demonstrate how the visual and written elements will work together to explore the beauty and meaning of sacred art.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book
  • Please ensure a list of the pieces of art that you would like to include is part of the detailed outline

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Soft Home - Bedding)

We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Soft Home - Bedding) to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption,C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.

Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business, contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth.
    • Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement.
    • Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools.
    • Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months.
  • RFP Ownership & Execution: Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award.
    • Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage.
    • Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses.
  • Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories.
    • Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished GoodsManufacturers Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) New categories / new products
    • Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing)
    • Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows
    • Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale)
  • Upstream Sourcing: Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions.
  • Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays.
    • e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)?

Qualifications

Required:

  • 12-15 years of experience in global procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in a consumer goods or retail environment
  • Proven track record running competitive RFP processes with international manufacturing partners
  • Hands-on experience building and leveraging clean sheets for cost negotiation
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making
  • Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, materials, and production teams

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

jobs.title: Design Team Lead - Ecommerce Marketing Agency
jobs.excerpt: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.
jobs.description:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.
The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.


General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

  • Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on
  • Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly
  • Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client
  • Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one
  • Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities
  • Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets
  • Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

  • Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign
  • Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute
  • Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline
  • Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work
  • Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

  • Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones
  • Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no
  • Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills
  • Onboarding new designers into how we work
  • Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation
  • Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

  • Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it
  • Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from
  • Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works
  • Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything
  • Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team
  • Taking on projects and initiatives delegated by the Service Director


Position Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month, consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement, meaning you cannot hold a position of a similar nature elsewhere while working for Hustler Marketing
  • A 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Performance reviews every 9 to 12 months, with the first one after 3 to 6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

You are a senior designer with at least five years behind you, and a portfolio of real client work across different brands and niches rather than a handful of personal projects. At least three of those years involve email marketing design.

You are expert in Figma. Not comfortable in it, expert. You should be able to build and maintain component libraries, and it helps if you follow what Figma releases closely enough to tell the team when something new is worth adopting. Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity is a useful complement, though we do not lean on either heavily.

You know more than one kind of design output. Email and SMS campaign design is the core of it, but ad images, GIFs, and short video edits come up constantly. Some basic knowledge of web design is a plus rather than a requirement, since landing pages appear from time to time and the team already handles most of that themselves.

What matters most is your eye, and how you talk about it. You can look at a design that is not performing and say what is wrong with it, in what order, and what you would change first. Then you can put that in a message a designer understands without needing a follow-up call. That skill is most of this job.

You are organised enough to run a week of work across several people, and to rearrange it at short notice without the whole thing falling apart.

You are the sort of person a team talks to. Ours is independent and reliable, and there are a few things they would like to see improved that are hard to change quickly. What matters to them is knowing their comments are being considered and answered, not that every one of them gets a yes.

You are curious. You notice when a process could be better and you do something about it instead of working around it. You bring people together across teams with workshops, documents, and tutorials without waiting to be asked.

And you notice detail, in your own work and in everyone else's.


Key traits for this position:

Strong visual judgement, and the vocabulary to explain it. Organised, and calm when the week changes shape. Approachable, and willing to have the honest conversation rather than the easy one. Curious about tools and trends without chasing every new thing. Detail-oriented past the point of comfort. At ease working remotely with people spread across several countries and time zones.


Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a graphic designer, with a minimum of 3 years in email marketing design
  • Expert-level Figma skills, including building and working from component libraries
  • Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity
  • Experience producing ad images, animated GIFs, and short video edits
  • An established portfolio showing on-brand, effective design work for a range of clients, stores, and niches
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating other designers. A formal lead title is not required, but you should have done the work
  • The ability to review someone else's design work and give written feedback that is specific and actionable
  • The ability to distribute and reorganise a team's weekly workload, including at short notice
  • A basic understanding of web design and landing pages is a plus
  • Experience with Klaviyo, or with a comparable email marketing platform, is a plus
  • Comfortable with Slack, Asana, Hubstaff, Google Workspace, and Figma, and willing to learn whatever else we use
  • Fluent written and spoken English. It does not need to be your first language, but you will be writing feedback and running calls in it every day
  • Remote work experience, ideally with a team spread across time zones
  • Available and responsive during office hours, Monday to Friday between 3 and 6 PM Barcelona time
  • Consistently working 30 to 35 hours per week, which is 140 hours per month
  • A stable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and the ability to join video calls

Bist du bereit, deine Studienzeit mit einer Prise echter Berufspraxis zu würzen? Möchtest du Teil eines Teams werden, das nicht nur Erfahrungen sammelt, sondern auch die Qualität unserer Plattformen maßgeblich beeinflusst? Dann werde Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Customer Care bei StudyCheck.

Deine Mission: Qualitätssicherung und mehr!

Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören (und melden uns in jedem Fall zurück!)

jobs.excerpt: Commercial Real Estate Transactions ManagerRole SummaryWe are seeking an analytical and action-oriented Real Estate Transactions Manager to be the “engine room” of our infrastructure acquisition team.
jobs.description:
Commercial Real Estate Transactions Manager

Role Summary

We are seeking an analytical and action-oriented Real Estate Transactions Manager to be the “engine room” of our infrastructure acquisition team. In this role, you will take identified sites and drive them from initial interest to a signed lease or purchase agreement. You’ll specialize in high-power EV charging sites, vehicle service centers, and parking facilities.

You will not just track deals; you will actively unblock them. You will serve as the central node connecting Legal, Finance, Technical and external broker teams, aggregating their inputs into clear, actionable Deal Summaries for our Investment Committee. Your goal is to maximize pipeline velocity while minimizing risk.

Key Responsibilities

1. Pipeline & Transaction Management

  • Funnel Velocity:Manage a high volume of active real estate transactions simultaneously, ensuring sites meet our location, technical and cost requirements, track critical dates and hold stakeholders accountable to timelines.

  • Negotiation Support:Outline key terms for Letters of Intent (LOIs). Partner with legal counsel to redline leases and related contracts, ensuring commercial terms align with company targets.

  • Deal Closing: Manage the closing checklist, ensuring all contingencies (zoning, title, survey, environmental) are cleared prior to execution.

  • Collaborate with local teams:Coordinate and streamline communication between Moove headquarters and the Japan team, driving efficient information sharing, cross-functional collaboration, and decision-making for real estate transactions.

2. Cross-Functional Due Diligence

  • The “Quarterback”:Act as the central point of contact during the diligence period. You are responsible for pulling in the right experts at the right time.

    • Construction & Utilities:Coordinate with the project delivery teams of external partners to validate site buildability and power availability (MW capacity).

    • Legal:Coordinate with internal and external counsel to advance zoning, land use, and permitting reviews.

    • Finance:Collaborate to ensure deal economics fit within our CAPEX and OPEX models.

3. Investment Analysis & Reporting

  • Deal Summaries:Synthesize complex data—financial models, site layouts, risk assessments, and legal constraints—into concise Investment Committee (IC) Memos that drive “Go/No-Go” decisions.

  • Financial Modeling:Run pro formas and sensitivity analyses to test deal viability under different scenarios (e.g., changing utility rates, construction cost variances).

  • Database Management: Maintain the “Single Source of Truth” in our real estate database (e.g., Google Sheets, Asana), ensuring all deal data is accurate and up to date.

Qualifications

Required

  • Education:Bachelor’s degree

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience, including a minimum of 3+ years of direct experience in commercial real estate transactions, development, or real estate private equity

  • The “Closer” Mindset:Demonstrated experience managing transactions from LOI to execution. You understand the mechanics of a real estate deal.

  • Analytical Skills:Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (financial modeling)

  • Language Skills:Business-level proficiency in both Japanese and English (written and spoken)

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business, or a related field

  • Experience with infrastructure or industrial assets (e.g., data centers, solar farms, logistics, or EV charging)

  • Understanding of municipal zoning and land-use entitlements

  • Familiarity with commercial or industrial real estate leases

  • Familiarity with Japanese real estate market dynamics, local regulations, and public bidding processes

Success Attributes

  • Structured Thinker:You can take a messy email thread involving a lawyer, an engineer, and a landlord, and turn it into a clear list of action items.

  • Bias for Action:You don’t wait for permission to follow up, remove blockers and rally cross-team efforts.

  • Risk Radar:You have an eye for detail and can spot “deal killers” (like a restrictive easement or a bad indemnity clause) early in the process.

  • Collaborative:You understand that getting a deal done requires building consensus across multiple internal teams with competing priorities.

Working Conditions (Statutory Disclosure)

1. Position

  • Job Title:Commercial Real Estate Transactions Manager

  • Legal Employer:Deel Japan K.K.

  • Contract Type: Indefinite term (正社員). No fixed-term renewal limit applies.

  • Employment Structure:This position is legally employed by Deel Japan K.K.

2. Duties & Scope of Change

  • Initial Duties: Identify a pipeline of real estate assets (lease and purchase) supporting fleet operations, including EV charging, parking and vehicle servicing depots; conduct due diligence and financial analysis; and lead contracting negotiations. Full responsibilities are set out above.

  • Scope of Change:May be reassigned to other duties within the Infrastructure team based on business needs.

3. Work Location & Scope of Change

  • Initial Location:Fully remote within Japan

  • Scope of Change:Remote work policy is subject to change based on company guidelines.

  • Passive Smoking Prevention:No designated company worksite; work is performed remotely. Smoking is prohibited at any company-arranged premises or event.

4. Working Hours & Overtime

  • Working Hours:9:00 – 18:00 JST

  • Break:60 minutes, taken at the employee’s election before 16:00

  • Scheduled Hours:8 hours per day / 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

  • Overtime:Yes — an average of approximately 4.2 hours per week (18 hours per month)

5. Compensation

  • Total Annual:¥9,750,000 – ¥11,250,000 (gross)

  • Base Salary:¥8,569,507 – ¥9,887,892 per year (¥714,126 – ¥823,991 per month), excluding the fixed overtime allowance

  • Fixed Overtime Allowance (固定残業手当): ¥1,180,493 – ¥1,362,108 per year (¥98,374 – ¥113,509 per month), paid as 18 hours of overtime per month

  • Overtime Beyond the Fixed Hours:Overtime in excess of 18 hours per month is paid additionally at the statutory premium rate.

  • Payment Schedule:Calculated at month end, paid on the 1st of the following month by bank transfer

  • Bonus: None

  • Commuter Allowance:None — this is a fully remote role. Business travel required by the Company is reimbursed separately.

6. Time Off & Holidays

  • Days Off:Saturdays, Sundays, and the 16 national public holidays

  • Annual Holidays (年間休日):120 days (104 weekend days plus 16 national public holidays)

  • Paid Annual Leave: 10 days granted after 6 months of continuous service with at least 80% attendance, increasing with length of service in accordance with the Labor Standards Act. At least 5 days must be taken each year.

  • Sick Leave:3 days of company-paid sick leave per year, in addition to statutory social-insurance benefits. A medical certificate is required for absences beyond 3 consecutive days.

  • Other Leave:Maternity, paternity/parental, childcare and family caregiver leave in accordance with Japanese law

7. Benefits & Insurance

  • Social Insurance:Enrollment in all mandatory social insurances: Health Insurance, Employees’ Pension, Employment Insurance, and Workers’ Compensation Insurance

  • Private Medical Insurance:Allianz, Gold – Single plan, provided in addition to statutory social insurance

8. Probation & Notice

  • Probation:3 months from the date of hire, with no extension

  • Conditions During Probation:Working conditions and salary remain unchanged.

  • Notice Period: 30 days during and after the probationary period

9. Non-Discrimination

No requirement or preference relating to age, gender, or nationality is stated or implied in this posting.

用地取得マネージャー

（Commercial Real Estate Transactions Manager）

職務概要

当社はインフラ用地取得チームの中核を担っていただける、分析力と行動力を兼ね備えた用地取得マネージャーを募集しています。候補地の発掘から、リース契約または売買契約の締結に至るまで、一連の取引を推進していただく仕事です。

単に案件の進捗を管理するだけでなく、案件が滞っている要因を見つけて自ら解消していく姿勢が求められます。法務・財務・技術部門、そして外部の仲介業者をつなぐ窓口として各方面からの情報を集約し、投資委員会に向けて分かりやすい案件サマリーにまとめていただきます。案件を進めるスピードを最大化しながら、リスクを最小限に抑えることが目標です。

主な業務内容

1. パイプライン・取引管理

  • パイプライン管理：複数の不動産取引を同時に進行させ、立地・技術・コスト面の要件を満たしているかを確認しながら、重要な期限を管理し、関係者が計画通りに動けるよう働きかけます。

  • 交渉サポート： LOI（意向表明書）の主要条件を整理します。法務担当と連携してリース契約や関連契約の内容を確認・修正し、商業条件が会社の目標に沿うよう調整します。

  • 契約締結：クロージングに向けたチェックリストを管理し、契約締結前に必要な条件（用途地域、権利関係、測量、環境調査など）がすべて解消されていることを確認します。

  • 現地チームとの連携：Moove本社と日本チーム間のコミュニケーションを調整・円滑化し、不動産取引に関する情報共有、部門横断的な協働、意思決定を推進します。

2. 部門横断のデューデリジェンス

  • デューデリジェンス期間中の窓口として、必要なタイミングで適切な専門家を巻き込みます。

    • 建設・インフラ設備：外部パートナーのプロジェクトチームと連携し、用地の開発可能性や電力容量（MW）を確認します。

    • 法務：社内外の弁護士と連携し、用途地域・土地利用・許認可に関する審査を進めます。

    • 財務： 案件の採算が会社のCAPEX・OPEXモデルに合致するよう連携します。

3. 投資分析・レポーティング

  • 案件サマリー作成：財務モデル、敷地レイアウト、リスク評価、法的制約といった複雑な情報を整理し、投資委員会（IC）向けの簡潔なメモにまとめ、実行可否の判断材料を提供します。

  • 財務モデリング：プロフォーマ（将来収支予測）や感応度分析を行い、電気料金や建設コストの変動など様々なシナリオのもとで案件の採算性を検証します。

  • データベース管理：不動産データベース（Google Sheets、Asanaなど）を常に最新かつ正確な状態に保ちます。

応募資格

必須要件

  • 学歴： 大卒以上

  • 経験： 実務経験7年以上、うち3年以上は商業用不動産取引、開発、または不動産プライベートエクイティにおける直接的な経験

  • クロージング経験： LOIから契約締結まで、案件をやり遂げた経験。不動産取引の一連の流れを理解していること

  • 分析力： Excel・Google Sheetsを用いた財務モデリングの経験

  • 語学力： 日本語・英語ともにビジネスレベル（読み書き・会話）

歓迎要件

  • 不動産、金融、経営学等の学位をお持ちの方

  • インフラ・産業用アセット（データセンター、太陽光発電所、物流施設、EV充電インフラなど）における経験

  • 用途地域や土地利用に関する法規制の理解

  • 商業用・産業用不動産の賃貸借契約に関する知識

  • 日本の不動産市場動向、各種規制、公募入札プロセスへの理解

求める人物像

  • 論理的思考力： 弁護士やエンジニア、地権者が入り乱れる複雑なメールのやり取りを整理し、明確なアクションリストに落とし込むことができる。

  • 主体性： 指示を待つのではなく、自らフォローアップを行い、障害を取り除き、部門を横断して周囲を巻き込みながら前に進められる。

  • リスク管理能力： 細部への注意力があり、制限的な地役権や不利な補償条項など、案件を左右しかねないリスクを早い段階で見抜くことができる。

  • 協調性： 案件を成立させるために、優先順位の異なる複数の社内チームとの合意形成をリードできる。

労働条件明示

職業安定法に基づく明示事項（2024年4月1日追加分を含む）

1. 募集職種

  • 職種名：用地取得マネージャー

  • 雇用主（募集者名）：Deel Japan 株式会社

About World Business Lenders

  • World Business Lenders (WBL) is a privately held portfolio lender specializing in real estate-secured business loans for underserved businesses. WBL operates with a fully remote, multinational workforce and an experienced executive leadership team.
  • Typically, the work schedule is from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, though additional hours may be required based on business needs.

About the Role

  • The Chief Operating Officer is responsible for providing operational leadership and coordination across the Company’s Lending Operations, including Intake, Processing, Valuation, Underwriting, Title, and Closing, as well as Asset Resolution and Loan Administration (Servicing).
  • This role will work closely with the senior leadership responsible for each function to ensure these areas operate as an integrated, end-to-end lending and asset lifecycle.
  • The Chief Operating Officer will focus on improving coordination within and between departments, establishing consistent processes and performance standards, identifying operational bottlenecks, monitoring key performance indicators, and ensuring that issues are addressed before they negatively impact lending, servicing, or asset resolution.
  • The Chief Operating Officer will focus on process integration, performance standards, operational efficiency, cross-functional coordination, and resolution of issues across the broader lending and asset lifecycle.
  • The position will report directly to the Chief Executive Officer and will serve as a key operational partner to executive leadership. The role will provide visibility into operational performance, risks, capacity, and opportunities for improvement across the functions within its scope.

What Success Looks Like

  • Improve coordination and accountability across Lending Operations, Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration.
  • Reduce operational bottlenecks and unnecessary handoffs.
  • Improve turnaround times and overall process efficiency.
  • Establish clear and measurable operational KPIs and improve visibility into performance for executive leadership.
  • Identify and resolve recurring operational issues.
  • Build scalable processes capable of supporting the company's continued growth.
  • Create a unified and efficient end-to-end operating model across the lending, servicing, and asset-resolution lifecycle.

What You'll Be Doing (Core Responsibilities)

  • Operational Leadership
    • Provide overall operational oversight across Lending Operations (Intake, Processing, Valuation, Underwriting, Title, and Closing), Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration (Servicing).
    • Work directly with the functional leaders of each area to establish priorities, processes, performance expectations, and operational objectives.
    • Ensure the functions within Lending Operations, Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration operate as an integrated process, with clear ownership and accountability for cross-departmental workflows.
    • Identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and communication breakdowns across the closing and asset lifecycle.
    • Develop and maintain standardized operating procedures, workflows, controls, service-level expectations, and escalation processes.
    • Monitor operational performance and provide regular updates and recommendations to the CEO.
  • Closing Operations Oversight
    • Work with Closing Operations leadership to monitor closing, funding, and related operational activities.
    • Identify recurring issues affecting Closing Operations or movement through the closing pipeline.
    • Coordinate with Valuations, Asset Resolution, Underwriting, Sales, Legal, Finance, and other relevant functions to improve execution.
    • Review operational reporting and identify trends requiring management attention.
  • Valuations Oversight
    • Work with Valuations leadership to ensure valuation activities are properly integrated into closing and asset-resolution processes.
    • Monitor valuation volume, turnaround times, quality, exceptions, and outstanding requests.
    • Identify delays that affect closing, underwriting, or asset resolution and establish appropriate prioritization and escalation processes.
    • Identify opportunities to improve valuation efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
  • Asset Resolution Oversight
    • Work with Asset Resolution leadership to ensure assets move efficiently through the resolution process.
    • Monitor resolution pipelines, aging, recoveries, dispositions, and other relevant operational metrics.
    • Identify operational issues affecting resolution outcomes and improve coordination with Closing Operations, Valuations, Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders.
    • Establish consistent processes for tracking assets through resolution and escalating matters requiring executive attention.
    • Identify opportunities to improve recovery outcomes, reduce cycle times, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Lending Operations Oversight
    • Provide operational oversight across Intake, Processing, Valuation, Underwriting, Title, and Closing.
    • Work with functional leaders to establish priorities, service levels, performance expectations, and escalation processes.
    • Identify bottlenecks, handoff issues, capacity constraints, and recurring problems across the lending pipeline.
    • Monitor operational reporting and KPIs across the lending lifecycle and recommend corrective actions.
  • Loan Administration (Servicing) Oversight
    • Provide operational oversight of Loan Administration (Servicing) and its integration with the broader lending and asset lifecycle.
    • Monitor servicing workflows, performance, capacity, exceptions, and cross-functional dependencies.
    • Identify opportunities to improve servicing efficiency, consistency, reporting, and coordination with Lending Operations and Asset Resolution.
    • Establish appropriate escalation and accountability processes for servicing issues that affect portfolio performance or customer outcomes.
  • End-to-End Process Management
    • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the company's end-to-end closing and asset lifecycle.
    • Map key processes across Closing Operations, Valuations, and Asset Resolution and clarify handoffs and responsibilities.
    • Develop dashboards, reporting, and KPIs that provide visibility into operational performance.
    • Analyze operational data to identify trends, capacity constraints, recurring problems, and improvement opportunities.
    • Lead cross-functional initiatives designed to improve efficiency, scalability, quality, and profitability.

Our audience is ambitious, self-aware and ready for the next level. Our content needs to speak to that with clarity, warmth and conviction.

The Role

We're looking for a genuine copywriter. Not a VA who writes, and not someone who simply runs prompts through AI and tidies up the output.

We want someone who understands persuasion, voice and structure, and who can make a reader stop, feel seen and take action.

You'll write across multiple channels, helping us communicate our message consistently while capturing the founder's unique voice.

This is an ongoing, part-time opportunity for an experienced writer who enjoys creating meaningful content and understands how words influence decisions.

  • Write compelling YouTube scripts and video hooks.

  • Write landing pages, sales pages and launch copy.

  • Solid understanding of direct-response copywriting principles, including hooks, offers, objections and calls to action.

  • Excellent written English with a natural, conversational tone.

Job Title: Senior Network Design Engineer

Department: Service Management Office > Network Operation Center

Reports to: Director of Engineering

Location: Remote, but located in the Spokane Valley, WA area

About NoaNet

NoaNet is a non-profit mutual corporation providing telecom solutions and services and is headquartered in Spokane Valley, Washington. For over 20 years, NoaNet has operated a reliable public open-access broadband network that today totals over 3,800 fiber miles and touches every county in Washington State. Our organization provides rural areas access to broadband services, supporting more than 100 last-mile providers that serve more than 260,000 customers. NoaNet’s owner/members are nine public utility districts and a joint operating agency. Learn more about NoaNet at

Why Work Here?

  • Overtime opportunities
  • Lease vehicle eligibility (where applicable)
  • Cell phone stipend (where applicable)
  • Travel reimbursement
  • Tuition reimbursement for approved job-related degree programs

Career Overview

NoaNet is seeking a qualified Senior Network Design Engineer responsible for the design, implementation, expansion, and lifecycle support of carrier-grade IP/MPLS, Ethernet, PON, LTE/wireless, and optical networks. This position serves as a senior technical authority for network architecture, customer solutions, complex implementations, and escalated operational issues. The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Sales, customers, and vendor partners from initial requirements through implementation and operational turnover.

Responsibilities

  • Design and engineer carrier-grade core, distribution, and access network solutions using IP/MPLS, Ethernet, optical transport, PON, LTE, wireless, and associated backhaul technologies.
  • Develop high-level and low-level network designs, equipment selections, bills of material, implementation plans, migration plans, and Methods of Procedure (MOPs).
  • Lead network capacity planning and system-requirement definition, and provide technical leadership for equipment and vendor evaluation and selection.
  • Lead or support complex network implementations, upgrades, migrations, and service turn-ups from concept through operational acceptance.
  • Design, deploy, configure, administer, and support PON systems and services, including provisioning through Nokia Altiplano, as well as LTE, wireless, and associated backhaul systems.
  • Establish network design standards and provide senior-level review and approval of network designs, configurations, standards, and implementation plans developed by others.
  • Serve as a senior engineering escalation point for complex multi-vendor network and service issues, including the highest-severity business-impacting outages that reach Engineering.
  • Develop and maintain network standards, design documentation, diagrams, technical support documentation, and operational handoff materials.
  • Partner with Project Management to identify technical dependencies, risks, resource needs, and implementation sequencing for assigned projects.
  • Lead customer professional-services engagements, including requirements gathering, network assessments, architecture and detailed design, equipment and vendor evaluation, implementation and migration planning, deployment and turn-up support, testing, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to provide technical sales support, define solution scope and equipment requirements, and present technical solutions to customers and prospective customers.
  • Architect new services and potential fiber routes, and participate in the research, evaluation, and development of network technologies and equipment platforms.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineering and operations personnel as appropriate.

Education, Training, Knowledge, Skills and Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, telecommunications, or a related discipline from an accredited college or university, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. Typically 8 or more years of progressively responsible experience designing, implementing, and supporting service-provider or large-scale enterprise networks.

  • Advanced knowledge of IP/MPLS network architecture, design, and troubleshooting.
  • Advanced understanding of IP routing, including BGP and interior gateway protocols such as OSPF.
  • Strong understanding of MPLS services and concepts, including L2/L3 VPNs, VRFs, resiliency, and high-availability design.
  • Advanced understanding of Ethernet switching and Carrier Ethernet concepts, including VLANs, QinQ, link aggregation, and Layer 2 service design.
  • Experience designing and troubleshooting high-capacity WAN and backbone networks, including 10G, 100G, and higher-speed interfaces.
  • Working knowledge of DWDM and optical transport concepts and components, including wavelengths, optical budgets, amplification, ROADMs, and coherent optics.
  • Experience designing, configuring, and troubleshooting QoS for WAN and service-provider networks.
  • Strong network troubleshooting skills, including the safe use of debug/trace tools, packet captures, logs, protocol analysis, and vendor diagnostic capabilities in production environments.
  • Knowledge of network security design and operations, including authentication/AAA, firewalls, remote access, access control lists, role and password management, and configuration management.
  • Ability to independently organize and prioritize work, manage changing priorities, and handle multiple complex technical assignments concurrently.
  • Strong written, verbal, organizational, and customer-facing communication skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or another applicable engineering discipline is strongly preferred.
  • Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification, Professional Engineer (PE) licensure, or demonstrated eligibility and active progress toward professional engineering licensure is preferred.
  • Experience working in a multi-vendor service-provider or telecommunications network environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Nokia SR OS routing platforms, Juniper routing platforms, Cisco switching platforms, and ADVA/Adtran or comparable optical transport systems.
  • Experience with PON management and provisioning platforms such as Nokia Altiplano, and with LTE, microwave, or other wireless access and backhaul systems.
  • Experience with network automation, scripting, APIs, or data-driven network management. Familiarity with technologies such as Python, Git, Linux, NETCONF/RESTCONF, model-driven management, telemetry, and SNMP is desirable.
  • Experience leading technical projects or workstreams from concept development through implementation and operational handoff.
  • Experience developing technical presentations, solution documentation, and customer-facing network designs.

Availability and Travel Requirements:

  • Primary job location: Washington State. Residency in WA, OR, or ID is required.
  • Frequent travel is required; the position should be based in a location with convenient access to air travel.
  • Participation in engineering escalation and on-call support for network outages is required.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 25+ pounds

Working Conditions:

  • Work is normally performed in an office environment with long periods of computer work.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote and collaborative

Driving Requirements

  • Must maintain and possess a valid driver’s license, proof of insurance, and a satisfactory driving record.

Location

Wage

    - $150,000/year DOE.

  • 457b Optional Supplement Plan

Director of Sales – Nursing Education

UWorld is seeking a high-impact Director of Sales to lead and grow our Nursing Education sales organization across the Western United States. This is a full-time sales leadership and coaching position responsible for managing, developing, and motivating a team of Nursing Account Executives while driving consistent revenue growth across the region.

The Director will serve as a strategic leader for the Western region, partnering closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Product, and other cross-functional teams to expand UWorld's presence within nursing programs and institutions.

We are looking for a dedicated sales leader who thrives on developing people, driving accountability, building strong sales processes, and creating a high-performance culture.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading B2B sales teams, preferably within nursing education, healthcare education, EdTech, educational publishing, or a related industry, and understands how to sell solutions that improve student outcomes and help nursing programs prepare students for high-stakes licensure examinations.

What You'll Own

Regional Revenue Growth

  • Lead the sales strategy and revenue performance for UWorld's Nursing Education business across the Western United States.
  • Develop and execute regional sales strategies designed to achieve and exceed revenue targets.
  • Drive new institutional business across nursing schools, colleges, universities, and other healthcare education organizations.
  • Develop strategies to expand UWorld's footprint within existing nursing programs and institutional partners.
  • Identify market opportunities, emerging trends, and areas for growth throughout the Western region.
  • Establish a predictable, scalable pipeline aligned with nursing program purchasing cycles and academic calendars.
  • Partner with senior sales leadership to develop regional goals, forecasts, and growth plans.

Sales Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Nursing Account Executives across the Western United States.
  • Establish clear expectations around revenue performance, pipeline generation, activity, customer engagement, and professional development.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, pipeline reviews, forecast meetings, and performance discussions.
  • Provide ongoing coaching focused on discovery, consultative selling, objection handling, negotiation, closing, and account expansion.
  • Listen to and evaluate sales calls using tools such as Gong to provide actionable coaching and development.

Nursing Education Market Development

  • Analyze sales performance metrics to identify trends, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Work closely with Sales Leadership to ensure alignment on national strategy, goals, and priorities.
  • Represent the voice of the Nursing Education sales organization in cross-functional meetings and strategic initiatives.
  • Help ensure the sales team has the messaging, tools, training, and resources needed to successfully engage nursing education customers.

What We're Looking For

  • 8–12+ years of B2B sales experience, with at least 5 years of successful sales leadership experience.
  • Proven success managing and developing high-performing sales teams.
  • Experience selling into nursing education, higher education, healthcare education, EdTech, educational publishing, SaaS, or a related industry.
  • Strong understanding of the nursing education ecosystem and the needs of nursing schools, faculty, and academic leadership is highly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of complex, multi-stakeholder B2B sales cycles.

jobs.excerpt: Who are we?  Hi!  👋 We are Ravelin!  We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems.
jobs.description:
Who are we?
Hi! 👋 We are Ravelin! We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems. Our goal is to make online transactions safer and help our clients feel confident serving their customers.
And we have fun in the meantime! We are a friendly bunch and pride ourselves in having a strong culture and adhering to our values of empathy, ambition, unity and integrity. We really value work/life balance and we embrace a flat hierarchy structure company-wide. Join us and you’ll learn fast about cutting-edge tech and work with some of the brightest and nicest people around - check out our Glassdoor reviews.
If this sounds like your cup of tea, we would love to hear from you! For more information check out our blog to see if you would like to help us prevent crime and protect the world's biggest online businesses.
The Team

You will be joining the Detection team, a team of machine learning engineers and data scientists. The Detection team is responsible for keeping fraud rates low by continuously training and deploying machine learning models. We aim to make model deployments as easy and error-free as code deployments. Google’s Best Practices for ML Engineering is our bible.

Our models are trained to spot multiple types of fraud, using a variety of data sources and techniques in real time. The prediction pipelines are under strict SLAs; every prediction must be returned in under 300ms. When models are not performing as expected, it’s down to the Detection team to investigate why.

The Detection team is core to Ravelin’s success. They work in a deeply collaborative partnership with the Data Engineering team to design the data architecture and infrastructure that powers our ML systems.

The Role

We are currently looking for an Engineering Manager to line manage ML engineers and drive innovation across our suite of fraud detection products. You’ll work closely with data scientists, product, engineering and our operations teams to develop ML models and ML products. Our ideal candidate is pragmatic, approachable and filled with knowledge tempered by past failures.
You will hire, coach and develop a talented machine learning team to deliver on the ML product and platform roadmap. You are in your element working with people. You’ll partner closely with senior members of Detection to discover new avenues for ML product innovation. From time to time, you’re excited to even do some software or model development yourself.

The work is not all green field research. The everyday work is about making safe incremental progress towards better models for our clients. The ideal candidate is willing to get involved in both aspects of the job – and understand why both are important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a key leader in establishing excellence within machine learning engineering and across the detection team
  • Line manage a team of machine learning engineers - providing coaching and guidance in support of the ongoing development and growth of your team
  • Propose and champion new machine learning methods and tools (including platforms that empower Data Science experimentation) to influence the technical roadmap and promote continuous innovation
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives with Data Engineering, Infra, and other teams to align on data architecture and ensure we make the right ML product decisions
  • Investigate model performance issues
  • Develop and deploy new models to detect fraud whilst maintaining SLAs

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience as an engineering manager, managing at least 3 people
  • You are a strong collaborator with colleagues outside of your immediate team, for example with data science, engineering, product, client operations teams and with senior leadership
  • You know how to manage and retain talented engineers from a diverse range of backgrounds and personalities. You can handle difficult management situations with tact, empathy and support
  • You have significant experience building and deploying ML models using the Python data stack
  • Familiarity with modern workflow orchestration tools such as Prefect, Kubeflow, Argo, etc.
  • You understand software engineering best practices (version control, unit tests, code reviews, CI/CD) and how they apply to machine learning engineering
  • Comfortable spending 30-40% of your time hands-on in the codebase and adapting your technical involvement based on the roadmap

Nice to haves
  • Pytorch or Tensorflow deep learning experience
  • Experience with Go, C++, Java or another systems language
  • Experience using dbt

Benefits

  • Flexible Working Hours & Remote-First Environment — Work when and where you’re most productive, with flexibility and support.
  • Comprehensive BUPA Health Insurance — Stay covered with top-tier medical care for your peace of mind.
  • £1,000 Annual Wellness and Learning Budget — Prioritise your health, well-being and learning needs with funds for fitness, mental health, and more.
  • Monthly Wellbeing and Learning Day — Take every last Friday of the month off to recharge or learn something new, up to you.
  • 25 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays + 1 Extra Cultural Day — Enjoy generous time off to rest, travel, or celebrate what matters to you.
  • Mental Health Support via Spill — Access professional mental health services when you need them.
  • Aviva Pension Scheme — Plan for the future with our pension program.
  • Ravelin Gives Back — Join monthly charitable donations and volunteer opportunities to make a positive impact.
  • Fortnightly Randomised Team Lunches — Connect with teammates from across the company over in person or remote lunches every other week, on us!
  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme — Save on commuting costs while staying active.
  • BorrowMyDoggy Access — Love dogs? Spend time with a furry friend through this unique perk.
  • Weekly Board Game Nights & Social Budget — Unwind with weekly board games or plan your own socials, supported by a company budget.

*Job offers may be withdrawn if candidates do not meet our pre-employment checks: unspent criminal convictions, employment verification, and right to work.​*

We are seeking detail‑oriented Elementary Physical Education Experts to review and revise college-level lessons. You will check to confirm the accuracy and clarity of lessons to ensure our content is a great resource for students.

This is a remote contractor role. You’ll work independently, manage your own time, and follow clear documentation to ensure consistent, high‑quality outcomes.

All work is paid hourly.

Job Description:


The subject-matter expert will carefully perform accuracy checks on provided college-level lessons. Minor edits may be required if the lesson is inaccurate in any way, and the expert must be capable of confirming that lessons are coherent and helpful for our users.

What You’ll Do

- Follow internal documentation to improve content accuracy and quality of provided lessons
- Review and approve college-level lessons in **Elementary Physical Education**
- Verify content is accurate, on-level, and appropriate for the related course

What Makes You a Great Fit

- Subject-matter expertise in **Elementary Physical Education**
- Strong editorial judgment for educational materials, with an eye for clarity, fairness, and learner‑appropriate rigor
- Ability to work independently and follow structured procedures

Required Qualifications

- A bachelor’s degree in Elementary Education, Physical Education, or Health
- 3-5 years of teaching experience in **Elementary Physical Education**
- Experience editing or developing educational content, assessments, or test‑prep materials
- Excellent written English and command of grammar, syntax, and tone for adult learners
- Familiarity with DEI guidelines for content publication
- Reliable internet and your own computer

Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in Elementary Education, Physical Education, or Health
College teaching experience in Elementary Education, Physical Education, or Health
Experience with content management systems

What We Offer:

  • Reliable Payments: You'll receive payments twice a month and automated invoicing for your work.
  • Remote Work: This is a fully online contracted work-from-home opportunity.
  • Flexibility: Basically, there are no requirements! Work when you want, where you want, as often as you want, with no minimums/maximums.
  • Support: Our supportive staff is available answer your questions and help you get up and running.

The Contract Process

  1. Complete the application and submit with your resume.
  2. Applications are approved and contracts sent on Wednesdays.
  3. Submit the contract within the 5-day signing window.
  4. The following Wednesday, you’ll receive onboarding instructions.

You can view a step-by-step overview of the contract process here: How to Become a Freelancer with Study.com

About Study.com

The mission of Study.com is to make education accessible, and over the last two decades we’ve become the leading online education platform, delivering a personalized learning experience across a broad continuum of education for over 30 million students, instructors, and professionals every month.

We help empower millions of learners to achieve their education and career goals. We focus on increasing access to education because we know information is the ultimate equalizer and that education is key to upward mobility.

Desirable:

jobs.description:
Position Title:

This position is a subject matter expert in global medical device and quality system regulations and is responsible for regulatory strategy and planning, authoring and submitting regulatory applications, assessing product design, manufacturing, labeling and quality system changes, authoring change impact assessments, and ensuring product labeling documentation, labels, promotional material, and product claims are accurate and compliant with global regulations. The Specialist will ensure adherence to company policy and procedures and will assist in maintaining quality control processes. This position will help the organization maximize the number of patients served while maintaining a high level of quality and safety through the support of the business functions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides regulatory support to product development and business teams including preparation of regulatory opinion documents, coordination of labeling activities, and review/approval of design control documentation, risk management reports, technical protocols/reports, clinical documentation and other outputs of product development.
  • Prepares/writes, submits, and manages global regulatory applications (including MDSAP markets, EU, and UK) as well as internal regulatory file documentation. Supports distributors and business partners in securing and maintaining regulatory clearances.
  • Maintains systems for tracking current projects and for projection of future activity loads.
  • Acts as company representative, developing and maintaining positive relationships with global regulatory agencies and business partners through oral and written communications.
  • Works professionally and cooperatively with cross-functional teams such as research and development, operations, quality, microbiology, packaging, medical affairs, and clinical affairs to ensure project success.
  • Assesses product design, labeling, quality system, manufacturing, and material changes for regulatory impact. Communicates changes effectively throughout the organization. Authors key portions of company responses to proposed standards, directives, policies and legislation regarding company products and systems.
  • Develops, processes, and maintains assigned departmental procedures, work instructions, and forms, and facilities training. Reviews and supports creation/updates of labeling procedures.
  • Supports the design, development, review, and approval of product labels, label items, advertising/promotional materials and product claims to assure accuracy, consistency and compliance to global regulatory requirements, as well as company and customer requirements. This includes verification of labels and advertising/promotional materials, and creation, verification, review, and processing of instructions for use.
  • Monitors and assesses changes to global regulatory regulations, directives, standards and guidance requirements (regulatory intelligence assessment). Manage project teams for completion of required activities to ensure compliance.
  • Supports regulatory aspects of the quality system and product non-conformities and leads assigned corrective and preventive action activities.
  • Front-room participation in internal audits. Back-room participation in external audits.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and may not necessarily comprise all essential functions.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED AND/OR PREFERRED:

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in a scientific or technical discipline, preferably in regulatory, engineering, or biological science plus 3 or more years of relevant experience; in lieu of degree, 5 or more years of relevant experience may suffice.

Strong understanding of other functional items including product development, design controls and risk management. Strong understanding of medical terminology, regulations, and guidelines related to medical devices and quality systems including FDA’s Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), MDD 93/42/EEC, MDR 2017/745, and ISO 13485.

Join the GTM Revolution at SalesCaptain — Where B2B Growth Happens

Since our beginnings in 2021, SalesCaptain has grown into a global force, working with fast-growing B2B brands, YC & Techstars startups, and Series B/C companies, helping them go to market using a predictable process.

We're looking for a systems-obsessed GTM Engineer to own and architect our outbound revenue infrastructure across client accounts. This is a hands-on builder role, the person who sits at the intersection of data, automation, AI, and Outbound strategy, designing fully automated outbound systems that run at scale.

This is a full-time, remote role, working EU hours.

About the role

This role is perfect for someone who loves Clay, lead generation, data, research, and outbound systems.

You will work closely with our GTM Strategists and Campaign Managers to turn ICPs into clean, accurate, campaign-ready lead lists. You will build Clay workflows, enrich data, identify the right companies and contacts, and help us improve the quality and speed of our outbound campaigns.

We are not looking for someone who only scrapes random leads.

We are looking for someone who understands why a lead is relevant, how to find better data, and how to build repeatable lead generation processes.

What you’ll do ✨

You will:

  • Architect end-to-end outbound systems: from ICP definition and TAM scoping all the way to campaign launch, CRM sync, and performance reporting
  • Build advanced Clay workflows: enrichment waterfalls, AI columns, Claygent researchers, conditional logic, custom API integrations
  • Design and implement signal-based triggers: job changes, funding rounds, hiring spikes, tech installs, web intent, and more (via RB2B, Trigify, Common Room, Clearbit, etc.)
  • Build multi-channel automation workflows using n8n, Make.com, and Zapier that connect data sources, enrichment layers, sequencers, and CRM
  • Use AI (Claude, GPT-4, and prompt engineering inside Clay) to generate hyper-personalized outreach at scale
  • Write lightweight scripts (Python/JS) or work with APIs directly when no-code tools aren't enough
  • Brief Outbound Strategists on new workflows, intent signals, and targeting approaches
  • Stay ahead of the tooling curve: test and adopt emerging data, enrichment, and AI tools before clients ask for them

Requirements

Who you are ❤️‍🔥

You should have:

  • You have 2+ years of experience building outbound or revenue systems: ideally at a B2B agency, GTM consultancy, or fast-moving SaaS company
  • You're a Clay power user, you don't just know the basics, you've built complex workflows with AI columns, Claygent, waterfalls, and custom API integrations
  • You think in systems, not tasks. When you see a manual process, your first instinct is to automate it
  • You're technical without being a developer. Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, and JSON, and you can write a basic Python or JS snippet when no-code isn't enough
  • You have a commercial mindset. You understand what a good ICP looks like, why a message fails, and how outbound performance connects to pipeline
  • You're obsessed with the GTM tooling ecosystem. You follow Clay updates, test new enrichment tools before anyone asks, and have opinions on what's worth adopting
  • You have native or advanced English (C1–C2). You can communicate clearly with clients and brief strategists on complex workflows without losing them
  • You're self-directed and accountable. You can take a client brief, define the system architecture, and ship without hand-holding
  • You have experience in the Tech, SaaS, or B2B software space, you understand the buyers our clients are targeting
  • Open to candidates coming from RevOps, outbound operations, Clay consulting, or senior BDR/SDR roles who have made the shift into systems building

What good looks like

You are successful in this role if:

  • GTM Strategists trust your lists and data quality without needing to recheck everything.
  • Prospect lists are relevant, accurate, and campaign-ready.
  • Clay workflows are clean, cost-efficient, and structured
  • You can explain why a company or contact fits the ICP.
  • You suggest better sourcing methods instead of only following instructions.
  • You help the team move faster without sacrificing quality.

This role is not for you if

  • You have never used Clay before.
  • You only know basic manual LinkedIn scraping.
  • You care more about lead quantity than lead quality.
  • You need very detailed instructions for every list.
  • You are not comfortable with repetitive but detail-heavy data work.
  • You do not enjoy experimenting with new tools and workflows.

Benefits
