jobs.title: Strategic Finance Lead
jobs.excerpt: About PlootoPlooto is a Canada-born fintech company on a mission to give small and mid-sized businesses the financial power to succeed on their own terms.
jobs.description:
About Plooto

Plooto is a Canada-born fintech company on a mission to give small and mid-sized businesses the financial power to succeed on their own terms. We make payments secure, accurate, and stress-free so businesses and their accountants can spend less time in the books, confidently manage cash flow, and make smarter decisions every day. We're a team that builds with integrity, agility, and heart, and we're looking for customer-minded pros who share our passion to join us as we scale.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Strategic Finance Lead to embed with the teams that drive our business — GTM, Product, and others as we grow — and raise the quality of decisions across the company. This is a partnering seat, not a reporting one: you’ll be in the room when a decision is being framed, not summarizing it afterward.

You’ll own the financial models for the areas you support, end to end. Because you own them, you’re in the decision rather than downstream of it. When a metric moves, your job isn’t to report that it moved — it’s to explain why, say whether that’s good or bad, and recommend what to do about it. When your business partners are weighing a decision, you’re the person quantifying the return.

You won’t inherit a playbook. You’ll write one — defining how finance partners with the business as the function grows.

The bar we’re setting

Today, a conversation about CAC often ends at “CAC went to $X because spend changed.” That’s arithmetic. We want a partner who asks the next questions: why did spend move — was it a deliberate test? What was the hypothesis, and how did it perform? How do we know our experiments are working? Is this a healthy shift or an early warning?

That’s the difference between reporting numbers and driving decisions, and it’s the heart of this role. We have good visibility into top-line trends; what we want is the ability to go a level deeper, consistently. That takes persistence — following the signal and going to find the data rather than waiting for it.

What you’ll cover

Today this role partners most closely with GTM — subscriber forecasting — and Product, where you’ll forecast TPV and revenue by product line and payment rail. As we grow, that will likely extend to Payments Strategy, Risk, and Operations.

We’ll be straight with you: we haven’t fully defined what finance support for those teams looks like yet, and we don’t expect one person to cover everything at once. Part of this job is helping us decide where finance partnership earns the most — and saying so when something should wait.

Your models serve two audiences: the teams they’re built for, and the company plan they roll into. We want models shaped to how each part of the business actually works that still connect cleanly to the central budget — so we plan from one picture instead of reconciling siloed models before a board meeting.

Build the system, not just the model

We’re not planning to solve capacity by adding people. We’d rather solve it with infrastructure: SQL pulling live from Databricks into models that refresh themselves, analysis that’s reproducible instead of rebuilt each month, and AI in the workflow where it genuinely saves time. You should be the kind of person who, faced with a manual process, gets slightly irritated and fixes it.

Much of our forecasting runs on Excel today, supported by live pipelines from our data warehouse. We know we’ll need something more scalable — and we’re deliberately open about what that is, whether a dedicated FP&A tool, a rebuild that leans harder on automation, or a different architecture altogether. You’ll help us decide and build it.

The team, and where this goes

Strategic finance is three people: the Senior Director (your manager), a Senior Financial Analyst, and you. The analyst owns the core FP&A engine — the company model, actuals, month-end performance analysis, and investor reporting. You’ll own the function-level models that feed it. You’re peers with distinct focus areas, and the expectation is that the two halves knit into one operating plan rather than running in parallel. Over time we want you cross-trained enough to cover for each other.

This is a senior individual-contributor role today, with no direct reports. We closed a funding round two months ago and are investing in growth — but we’re deliberately scaling this team through better systems and AI leverage rather than headcount. If we do add analysts, this is the person who’d oversee them. We’re not promising a management track; we’re telling you it’s a live possibility, and that the route to it is making the function work better, not bigger.

You’ll work closely with the CFO, with exposure to the CEO, and your work will feed directly into what we take to our board and investors.

What good looks like in your first year

  • The models for your areas are rebuilt on clear drivers, with sensitivities and scenarios that leadership actually uses when making a call.
  • Finance is in product and GTM decisions early enough to shape them — not brought in to forecast something already decided.
  • We can trace what specific initiatives contribute against a base case, so “did that work?” has an answer.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own driver-based financial models for the business areas you support, built around how each team actually operates.
  • Embed with those teams — challenge assumptions, frame tradeoffs, and bring a return-on-investment lens to decisions before they’re made.
  • Explain the why behind the numbers — investigate what moved a metric, judge whether it’s good or bad, and turn that into a recommendation. Help teams get closer to their own KPIs and the data behind them.
  • Connect your models to the company plan so each area rolls cleanly into the central budget.
  • Build and maintain live data pipelines — write SQL against our data warehouse (Databricks) to keep models refreshing on live data rather than manual pulls.
  • Help modernize our planning infrastructure with the Senior Director — tooling, automation, or architecture.
  • Distill complex analysis into crisp stories for executive and board audiences.
  • Partner with the Senior Financial Analyst to keep forecasting, budgeting, and reporting coherent as Plooto scales.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in strategic finance, FP&A, or business analytics — ideally in fintech, SaaS or another recurring-revenue business.
  • Payments or transaction economics — take rate, transaction mix across rails, cost per transaction, and how volume converts to revenue. This is core to how Plooto makes money, and you’ll be modeling it.
  • SaaS metrics in practice — ARR, MRR, churn, CAC, payback, LTV — and the judgment to know when a movement matters.
  • Hands-on SQL against a warehouse (Databricks or similar) wired into Excel, building live-refresh workflows rather than static exports.
  • Advanced Excel and driver-based modeling, with the ability to rebuild as the business and your understanding change.
  • Comfort reasoning about cause, not just correlation — you can tell a deliberate test from a drift, ask what the hypothesis was, and judge whether a result is real.
  • Exceptional communication — you can make a complex analysis simple and persuasive for technical and non-technical audiences, and hold your own with business leaders.
  • A partnering instinct, and the judgment to prioritize. With fluid scope and a lot of inbound, you’ll need to decide what earns your time and say no clearly.
  • Using AI tools to automate analytical workflows and work faster.
  • Experience helping select or implement FP&A planning tooling.

Why Become a Plootonian?

If you're looking to make a meaningful impact, look no further. We're transforming the payments space in North America by delivering an unrivalled product experience to solve a real and pressing problem for SMBs.

The biggest reason small businesses fail is poor financial management and cash flow — and Plooto fixes that. We have strong product-market fit, a massive opportunity ahead, and the backing of experienced fintech leaders.

You'll join a team that cares deeply about customer impact, takes pride in our craft, and moves with urgency. We're just getting started — and you'll help shape the next chapter of our growth story.

Join Plooto and be part of a mission that matters.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Plooto is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can thrive. We know great teams are built through diverse thinking, and we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.

Accommodation is available throughout the recruitment process in accordance with applicable accessibility legislation. If you require accommodation at any stage, please let us know—we’re happy to work with you.

This posting is for one available position. Compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment with the role.

Recognized globally as a Great Place to Work and the recipient of multiple partner excellence awards, BIG is built on collaboration, innovation, and delivering measurable business outcomes for enterprise clients. We are a team of experienced technology professionals who enjoy solving complex challenges, celebrating wins together, and helping customers modernize with confidence.

AN EXCITING OPPORTUNITY WITH BIG AND CONVENE AI

BIG is excited to be partnering with Convene AI, an AI-focused technology company developing innovative solutions that leverage artificial intelligence to solve real-world business challenges.

As part of this partnership, we are looking for talented professionals to join BIG and work directly on Convene AI projects and initiatives. You will initially be hired as an employee of Bits In Glass, while working closely with the Convene AI team and contributing to the development and growth of their AI solutions.

The role is expected to remain on BIG’s payroll for approximately 12–18 months, with the intention of transitioning to a permanent position directly with Convene AI following this period, subject to business requirements and transition arrangements.This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an emerging AI organization at an important stage of its growth, while benefiting from the support, culture, and established consulting expertise of Bits In Glass.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You are the tip of the spear. You own the client relationship, the scope, and the definition of done. You decide what gets built, what does not, and when to tell a client no. This is not an internal product management role and it is not a program management role. You will be embedded with an enterprise client, running discovery, converting messy business problems into AI requirements a pod can build against, and holding a weekly release cadence together while stakeholders change their minds. Because our contracts are fixed-fee and outcome-based, your scope discipline is directly connected to whether the engagement is profitable. That is real commercial responsibility and we will treat you

accordingly.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Run discovery: map the current process, quantify where the pain and the money are, and identify where an agent creates measurable value rather than novelty.
    • Convert business problems into AI requirements with acceptance criteria that can actually be tested, working with the AI Quality Engineer to make them measurable before build starts.
    • Own the outcome definition on outcome-based contracts: what "working"means, how it is measured, who signs off, and what happens if the threshold is missed.
    • Manage the client-provided domain expert: secure their time in writing up front, and escalate immediately when their availability slips. Weak domain SME support is the single most common cause of slipped go-lives in this model, and catching it early is your job.
    • Manage scope ruthlessly. Weekly releases only work if the backlog is disciplined and someone is willing to be unpopular.
    • Run the weekly cadence: demo to the client, capture feedback, re-prioritise, and keep the pod pointed at the highest value work.
  • Own stakeholder alignment across business, IT, security, procurement, and legal, and get security and procurement engaged in week one rather than week nine.
    • Partner with the client's change and adoption team so the system gets used, not just delivered.
    • Track and report delivery health: burn, risk register, decision log, and benefits realisation against the agreed outcome.
    • Surface commercial risk early. Scope creep, weak executive sponsorship, and integration surprises are margin erosion, and you are the early warning system.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 3–8 years in product ownership, delivery management, or client-facing consulting, including at least 2 years shipping software rather than only running programmes.
    • A track record delivering under fixed-price or outcome-based commercial terms, where scope discipline had financial consequences.
    • Fluency in agile delivery at a genuine weekly release cadence, not two-week ceremony.
    • Enough technical literacy to challenge an engineer's estimate and to understand why a retrieval pipeline is returning poor answers. You do not need to write code.
    • A working understanding of what LLM-based systems can and cannot reliably do, and the confidence to tell a client when their request is not feasible.
    • Executive presence. You will hold steering committees with client CIOs, COOs, and business unit heads.
    • Experience in at least one of insurance, financial services, healthcare, or a comparably regulated industry.
    • Excellent written communication. Ambiguity that survives your documentation becomes a defect later.
    • Legally entitled to work in Canada and willing to travel to client sites.

BONUS POINTS

  • Prior experience at a top-tier strategy consultancy, Big Four, or a specialist delivery boutique.
    • A background as a business analyst, engineer, or data professional before moving into product.
    • Familiarity with AI quality concepts: evaluation design, acceptance thresholds, and human-in-the-loop workflow design.
    • Experience running engagements alongside a separate change management partner.

• Bilingual English and French.

WHY JOIN CONVENEAI

  • You will own client outcomes, not status reports.
    • Four-person pods mean your decisions translate into shipped software within days.
    • Outcome-based commercial terms mean the work is judged on whether it created value, which is a more interesting standard to be held to.
    • You will work directly with senior operators who have led AI delivery at Fortune 500 scale.
    • Real influence over how ConveneAI's delivery model evolves as we scale from the first pods to many.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT QUINCEQuince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo.
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Jewelry)

We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Jewelry) to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption,C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.

Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business, contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth.
    • Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement.
    • Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools.
    • Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months.
  • RFP Ownership & Execution: Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award.
    • Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage.
    • Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses.
  • Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories.
    • Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished GoodsManufacturers Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) New categories / new products
    • Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing)
    • Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows
    • Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale)
  • Upstream Sourcing: Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions.
  • Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays.
    • e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)?

Qualifications

Required:

  • 12-15 years of experience in global procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in a consumer goods or retail environment
  • Proven track record running competitive RFP processes with international manufacturing partners
  • Hands-on experience building and leveraging clean sheets for cost negotiation
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making
  • Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, materials, and production teams

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range
$164,000—$240,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. jobs.description:
Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.
  • Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.
  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.
  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.
  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

To support our mission and operational structure, we are only able to hire team members who are already authorized to work in the Unites States. Candidates MUST have existing legal work authorization, as visa sponsorship is not available.

We are looking for someone located in the Central or Eastern parts of the US.

About Our Mission

Greater Europe Mission is a community of disciple-makers that longs to see Europe transformed by Jesus. For over 70 years, our workers have created relationships and environments of grace where people who are near or far from God feel welcome.

On a continent where less than 3% of the population claim a relationship with Jesus, the light of the gospel is spreading! As more and more Europeans are awakened to hope in Jesus, the need for effective, reproducible discipleship is at an all time high.

Our US-based team works to connect the people of God in the US to the mission of God in Europe through recruiting, creating church partnerships, and raising funds to support the ministry.

Position Summary: (This is a remote position)

The Donor Officer serves on the GEM US Development team with responsibility for building, cultivating, and stewarding relationships with donors and prospects in order to advance the mission of Greater Europe Mission. The ideal candidate has experience in recruiting, sales, or donor development. They are passionate about building new relationships and working alongside a team that is enthusiastic about the mission field of Europe.

GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES FOR ALL GEM STAFF

  • Maintain personal spiritual vitality and a healthy life rhythm.
  • Live and work in alignment with GEM’s mission, vision, and core values.
  • Participate in required staff meetings, retreats, and organizational gatherings.
  • Communicate in a timely, professional, and gracious manner with colleagues, donors, and partners.
  • Uphold GEM policies, procedures, and standards of confidentiality and integrity.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

Donor Care & Relationship Management

  • Manage an assigned caseload of donors and prospects, focusing on cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Conduct regular donor visits and relational touchpoints (in person, phone, and virtual).
  • Encourage deeper donor engagement by clearly communicating GEM’s mission, vision, and ministry impact in Europe.
  • Identify and help qualify new donor prospects in collaboration with the Development team.

Stewardship & Engagement

  • Ensure donors receive timely, thoughtful communication and understand the impact of their generosity.

  • Participate in donor events and gatherings such as Vision Summit, Vision Weekend, and regional or small-group events.

Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with the VP of Development and Development team to support fundraising strategies and goals.

TRAVEL

This position requires up to 50% travel. Some of the travel is international.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Clear Christian faith and personal alignment with GEM’s mission and values.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to manage multiple relationships, priorities, and follow-up effectively.
  • Willingness and ability to travel for donor visits and events.

Preferred

  • Experience managing a donor portfolio or working in major or mid-level giving.
  • Experience in a nonprofit, ministry, or mission-sending organization.

jobs.title: Sr. FP&A Analyst
jobs.excerpt: At InStride, people are our purpose. We believe that investing in people is the most powerful way to drive success—for individuals and organizations alike.
jobs.description:
At InStride, people are our purpose.

We believe that investing in people is the most powerful way to drive success—for individuals and organizations alike.

As a public benefit corporation, we partner with leading employers to unlock opportunities for their employees, providing access to top-tier education programs that align with their employees’ career goals and the company’s business goals.

Our mission goes beyond skill-building; we're here to empower our partners’ employees to advance their careers, elevate their expertise, and achieve meaningful personal and professional growth.

No matter the team you’re on, our dedication to the success of our partners and their employees is what drives us. If you're passionate about making a difference and driving educational and professional advancement, InStride is the place for you.

To get a better feel for our culture, watch more here.

Candidates must be located in one of the following states to be considered eligible for employment: AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, TX, VA, WA, WI.

What we’re looking for InStride is looking for a Senior Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to join a high-performing FP&A practice (processes, software tools, etc.) that can scale with our emerging, high growth company. This role will perform analysis and prepare reports to support the annual budget process, contribute to financial and operational close and reporting processes, and assist in putting together the financial forecast.

The ideal candidate will be able to partner with leaders and team members to provide financial / analytical guidance and influence key decisions that enable the company to achieve its core mission and improve enterprise value. This candidate will be a dynamic individual who can objectively research and analyze sophisticated issues and present recommendations in a clear and simple way to elicit support from other team members.

This is a hands-on seat on a small team. You will own recurring deliverables end to end - the model, the tie-out, the commentary and the slide - for audiences that include our executive team, our board, our sponsor and our lenders.

Skills we’d love to see you show off

  • Financial Analysis: Expertise in modeling, variance analysis, and budgeting to drive informed decisions.
  • Collaborative Problem-Solving: Skilled in partnering across teams to shape strategy and drive business results.
  • Systems Proficiency: Experienced with tools like NetSuite, Cube and Tableau, focusing on automation and process improvement.
  • AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools to move faster on analysis, drafting and quality checks — and clear-eyed about where they help, where they don’t, and what still has to be verified by hand.
  • Presentation & Communication: Ability to translate complex data into clear insights for leaders and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: Instinct to tie numbers out across files and systems before they go to a CFO, a board or an auditor, and to flag a variance rather than quietly bridge it.
  • Curiosity & Learning: Passion for understanding trends and continuously developing skills.
  • Analytical Thinking: Capable of identifying problems and offering innovative growth solutions.
  • Adaptability: Thrive in fast-paced settings, managing priorities with a high standard of work.
  • Cultural Awareness: Strong in navigating diverse environments, fostering inclusion, and building relationships.

Who you are

  • You believe in the power of education to transform lives and are motivated by the impact we’re making. You share our values of inclusivity, authenticity, and commitment to social good.
  • You enjoy working closely with others and believe that the best solutions come from diverse perspectives. You’re eager to partner with colleagues from across the business, bringing financial insights that drive collective success.
  • You’re naturally curious and constantly seeking out new knowledge, whether it’s about market trends, financial systems, new AI tooling, or how to be a better teammate.
  • You are proactive and take initiative. You thrive in environments where things move quickly and priorities can shift, and you’re ready to adapt without missing a beat.
  • You are dependable in the unglamorous moments. When something lands late in the day or needs one more check before it goes out, you pick it up and close it out without being chased.
  • You understand that people are at the core of what we do. You can navigate different personality types and work styles with ease, creating a positive and psychologically safe environment for everyone.
  • You’re passionate about making a difference, not just for business but for society. You seek roles where your work can have a lasting impact, and you’re excited about being part of a mission-driven company.

EXPERIENCE WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years of finance experience, preferably in a high-growth technology company or consulting firm
  • Prior experience working for a private-equity backed company, including the reporting cadence that comes with a sponsor and lenders
  • Proven track record of achievement and delivering impactful results
  • Strong background in financial analysis with strong problem-solving skills
  • Consistent track record to distill issues into simple, structured frameworks that can be clearly communicated to key leaders and partners inside and outside of the company
  • Experience partnering with leaders across sales, marketing, R&D, operations, etc.
  • A curiosity and aim to thoroughly analyze issues and to come forward with clear recommendations for moving forward
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with individuals at all levels of the organization
  • Proven ability in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the challenge
  • Experience working in key systems to help improve and automate the finance function (ERP, FP&A, Analytics, CRM, etc.)
  • Prior experience with NetSuite, Cube and Tableau is a plus
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in finance or analytical workflow is a plus — we care more about judgment in applying them than about any tool
  • Ability to collaborate across teams internally and with partners e.g. with universities, corporate clients and the team

How you will create impact

PLANNING & FORECASTING

  • Assist in updating the long-range financial forecast model and partner with other teams across the organization to ensure that the modeling assumptions are reasonable and current
  • Help drive the annual budgeting process for functional areas, maintaining the budget templates and scenarios that functional leaders build from
  • Own headcount and contractor cost forecasting - roster-level detail, burden rates and role-by-role phasing — and reconcile it back to the plan each cycle

CLOSE, REPORTING & AUDIT

  • Assist in the creation, consolidation and distribution of monthly reports and critical metrics to key partners
  • Support the monthly financial close process and the annual financial audit as required
  • Prepare the recurring YTD and full-year reporting packages requested by our external auditors, lenders and sponsor, and stand behind the tie-outs between the model, the general ledger and the reported figures
  • Perform detailed budget vs. actual variance reports to each functional leader within the organization and support in presenting/distributing

BUSINESS PARTNERING & DECISION SUPPORT

  • Build and manage relationships across the business and be the POC for analytical support for assigned teams
  • Build decks and presentations for executives, the board of directors, and partners/clients — including P&L commentary, revenue bridges and segment or KPI pages that hold up to line-by-line scrutiny
  • Provide decision support (return on investment, NPV, benchmarking, etc.) on company decisions (partnerships, customer contracts, M&A activities, etc.)
  • Analyze vendor, cloud and other significant spend categories, separating what scales with the business from what does not, and bring cost-efficiency opportunities forward

SYSTEMS, AUTOMATION & AI

  • Help research, select, implement, and refine processes and systems to optimize the efficiency and performance of the FP&A team
  • Work in our FP&A platform (Cube) and ERP (NetSuite) to maintain scenarios, data fetches and mappings, so the plan and the actuals stay connected without manual rebuilds
  • Put AI to work on the parts of the job that are repeatable — first-draft variance commentary, reconciliation checks, deck production, summarizing source documents — and apply judgment about where a human tie-out is still required before anything reaches an executive audience
  • Develop an understanding of the markets, customers, and products to provide more substantial financial and analytical support to the organization
  • Perform ad required hoc research, analysis, and reporting

Compensation

At InStride, final offer amounts are dependent on multiple factors including location, depth of experience, interview performance and equity with other team members.

We encourage you to talk with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits available for this role.

Compensation range:
$100,000—$115,000 USD

We are looking for someone who is not only technically skilled, but also enthusiastic about making a meaningful impact. If this description resonates with you, we're excited about the possibility of having you on our team. As a skills-driven employer, we encourage you to apply if there is a skill-fit, even in the absence of years of experience.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At InStride, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this role!

Benefits @ InStride

As an organization that champions investing in people, it’s critical we walk the talk. That’s why InStride employees are eligible to enroll in 2,800+ online certificate and degree programs through our Step Forward program. Unlike traditional tuition reimbursement programs, InStride covers your tuition upfront, regardless of your course of study, degree type, or school - eligible to employees starting Day 1.

This role is also eligible for the following benefits:

  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Paid family leave
  • Best-in-class health care benefits
  • And more!

InStride Diversity and Inclusion Statement

At InStride, we foster a culture of belonging, we support authenticity and intersectionality, and we embrace and appreciate our differences. We do this by building a diverse pipeline of talent and ensuring equitable access to opportunities, information and leadership. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let your recruiter know.

Policies & Disclosure

InStride recommends employees have their COVID vaccinations. InStride may require employees to have COVID vaccination before entering the office or attending any InStride-related even in the future. However, we do not require this at this time.

For questions on how we use personal information of job applicants, please refer to InStride's Job Applicant Privacy Policy.

Beware of recruiting scams. InStride does not require a financial transaction or any financial account information to be eligible for employment. If you receive a message purporting to be from InStride asking you for a financial transaction, your financial account information, or any other sensitive information, please do not respond and let us know immediately at .

About InStride

InStride is a human capital management company that helps organizations retain talent, upskill employees, and fill critical workforce roles through education programs. By breaking down barriers to learning, fostering career growth aligned with organizational goals, and simplifying program management, InStride delivers lasting impact. Partnering with forward-thinking companies like Labcorp, Adidas, and SSM Health, InStride drives meaningful social and business outcomes by providing access to life-changing education. jobs.description:
SRA’s mission is to level up every day to protect our clients and their customers. This begins with our team members and their experience. SRA prides itself on maintaining a culture where team members have a shared sense of support and belonging, consistent with our It’s Personal company value. At SRA, we prioritize transparent career pathing, varied DEI programming and community groups, competitive benefits including mental health support, and an emphasis on a sustainable, healthy, and engaging work culture. SRA values a diverse workplace and strongly encourages people of all backgrounds to apply.

 

Summary/Objective 

 

This role is part of SRA's Advisory Services team, with a focus on Purple Teams. jobs.title: Senior Facilities Manager
jobs.excerpt: Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Senior Facilities Manager to join our team.
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Senior Facilities Manager to join our team.

Position Description

Oklo is hiring a Senior Facilities Manager to lead facility operations across our offices, laboratories, warehouses, test facilities, and other non-reactor spaces. This is a hands-on role responsible for managing day-to-day facility needs, projects, vendors, and requests while establishing consistent company-wide practices.

The Senior Facilities Manager will maintain visibility across Oklo’s facilities, identify capacity and infrastructure needs, and coordinate expansions, moves, and new locations. This person will initially serve as the primary individual contributor, using vendors and local site contacts as appropriate and recommending additional support as the portfolio grows.

The Senior Facilities Manager owns Oklo’s facilities systems and supports physical material operations while coordinating with each function’s designated authority. The role focuses on non-reactor corporate and operational facilities and is separate from Aurora powerhouse development, design, and construction.

Specific responsibilities may include:

Facilities Portfolio Real Estate and Space Planning

  • Maintain an accurate portfolio of facility use, capacity, constraints, lease terms, costs, and planned changes.
  • Establish an intake and decision process for new space, expansions, moves, and facility modifications.
  • Translate business needs into facility plans and support site searches, due diligence, lease activity, landlord relationships, and facility exits with Legal and Finance.
  • Assess facilities options to meet Oklo needs in various geographies including but not limited to short vs long term leasing, use of options such as but not limited to WeWork vs other solutions, etc.

Facility Operations and Projects

  • Serve as the primary contact for facility needs and coordinate resolution through local teams, vendors, contractors, and landlords.
  • Support maintenance, repairs, utilities, inspections, service contracts, workplace needs, and other recurring operations.
  • Manage facility openings, moves, tenant improvements, and modifications with internal and external partners.
  • Coordinate insurance, IT, cybersecurity, Security, EHS, Quality, and operational requirements throughout each facility’s lifecycle.
  • Establish practical standards for preventive maintenance, emergency procedures, compliance, records, and service levels.

Business Management and Cross Functional Coordination

  • Own facilities processes, tools, records, standards, and performance measures.
  • Develop operating and capital plans and manage budgets, forecasts, contracts, vendors, and service providers.
  • Identify risks, recommend practical solutions, and manage approved actions through implementation.
  • Monitor workload and recommend additional staffing or local support when justified.

Receiving Storage and Logistics Support

  • Partner with Procurement, Engineering, and site teams to support receiving, storage, material handling, and shipping.
  • Coordinate with Quality, EHS, and Security on requirements for controlled, hazardous, sensitive, or high-value materials.
  • Help resolve facility issues affecting material flow, storage capacity, or on-site logistics.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in facilities, workplace operations, construction management, industrial operations, warehousing, logistics, or a related function.
  • Experience supporting a multi-site portfolio that includes laboratories, warehouses, test facilities, light industrial space, or advanced manufacturing.
  • Hands-on experience with facility operations, vendors, maintenance, moves, tenant improvements, leases, landlords, and service contracts.
  • Experience managing budgets, capital plans, forecasts, and facility or space decisions.
  • Ability to establish scalable practices, work across functions, communicate with executives, and operate effectively in changing conditions.
  • Ability and willingness to travel among Oklo facilities and prospective locations.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience in nuclear, aerospace, energy, advanced manufacturing, research laboratories, defense, semiconductor, or another regulated or technically complex industry.
  • Experience establishing a facilities or site-operations function in a growing organization.
  • Familiarity with facilities, work-order, inventory, warehouse-management, enterprise resource planning, or space-planning systems.
  • Experience supporting controlled materials or improving receiving, inventory, storage, handling, and shipping processes.
  • Relevant credentials in facilities, construction, project management, safety, or supply chain.

Competencies

We are looking for a Senior Facilities Manager who is:

  • A hands-on owner who can manage the full portfolio while solving practical site problems
  • A builder of simple systems and standards that can scale without creating unnecessary process.
  • Comfortable moving between facility strategy, lease and vendor discussions, project execution, and day-to-day operations.
  • Commercially astute and able to evaluate costs, negotiate agreements, and make sound recommendations.
  • Passionate about clean energy
  • An optimist at heart
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in a modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $140,000 - $180,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

📍 Standort: Köln/Koblenz - Remote | 📆 Start: ab sofort oder nach Absprache

Du hast ein gutes Gespür für KI, Software, Prozesse und Automationen – und Lust, in einem jungen, dynamischen Team wirklich etwas zu bewegen?
Dann komm zu uns und hilf dabei, unsere Unternehmensgruppe digital noch besser, effizienter und zukunftsfähiger aufzustellen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  1. KI im Alltag sinnvoll integrieren (ChatGPT, Claude usw.)

  2. unsere Programme und ggf. neue (SaaS Lösungen) im Alltag betreuen

  3. neue Softwarelösungen auswählen, einführen und strukturiert aufbauen

  4. Prozesse digitalisieren und vereinfachen

  5. Schnittstellen und Systeme miteinander verbinden

  6. Automationen für wiederkehrende Aufgaben entwickeln

  7. bei Unternehmensübernahmen neue Standorte, Teams, Systeme und Prozesse strukturiert in unsere bestehende Organisation integrieren

  8. Standards, Abläufe und digitale Strukturen gruppenweit mit aufbauen und vereinheitlichen

  9. Kollegen bei Tools, Fragen und Problemen unterstützen

  10. Fehler finden und Lösungen umsetzen

Die wichtigste Aufgabe: Das weitere Wachstum unserer Unternehmensgruppe digital, prozessseitig und operativ langfristig mitgestalten.

Was dich bei der Demeco Unternehmensgruppe erwartet:

✔️ Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Ob Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: Wir gestalten die Rolle so, dass sie zu deiner Situation und zu unserem Bedarf passt.

✔️ Flexible Arbeitszeiten & hybrides Arbeiten: Du arbeitest mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Flexibilität und der Möglichkeit, Aufgaben je nach Thema auch hybrid umzusetzen.

✔️ Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du arbeitest nicht nur bestehende Abläufe ab, sondern kannst Prozesse mit aufbauen, verbessern und neue Standards mitsetzen.

✔️ Direkter Einfluss auf Wachstum und Struktur: Deine Arbeit hat sichtbaren Einfluss darauf, wie wir als Unternehmensgruppe effizienter, digitaler und skalierbarer wachsen.
✔️ Einblick in eine wachsende Unternehmensgruppe: Du bekommst direkte Einblicke in die Strukturen, Abläufe und Entwicklung einer dynamischen Unternehmensgruppe.

✔️ Modernes Arbeitsumfeld in Köln & Koblenz: Dich erwartet eine moderne Bürostruktur mit kurzen Wegen, direkter Kommunikation und einem professionellen, jungen Umfeld.

✔️ Starke Zusammenarbeit im Team: Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, in dem man sich gegenseitig unterstützt, offen kommuniziert und gemeinsam Lösungen voranbringt.

✔️ Faire Vergütung & langfristige Perspektive: Wir bieten dir eine attraktive Vergütung und ein Umfeld, das auf nachhaltige Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt ist.

✔️ Faire Unternehmenskultur mit familiärem Charakter

Die Demeco Real Estate Service GmbH ist eine wachsende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Facility Management und Gebäudeservices für Wohn- und Gewerbeimmobilien. Wir entwickeln Strukturen, Services und Prozesse nicht nur operativ weiter, sondern bauen unser Unternehmen Schritt für Schritt professioneller, digitaler und skalierbarer auf.

Dabei verbinden wir unternehmerisches Wachstum mit einem klaren Anspruch an Qualität, Effizienz und saubere Abläufe. Genau deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die nicht einfach nur mitlaufen, sondern mitdenken, Verantwortung übernehmen und den Aufbau eines starken Unternehmens aktiv mitgestalten wollen.

Unser Leistungsspektrum reicht heute bereits von Gebäudereinigung, Glas- und Fassadenreinigung über Hausmeisterservice und Gartenpflege bis hin zu weiteren Dienstleistungen rund um die Immobilie. Diese Breite macht uns im Alltag stark – und die Rolle für dich besonders spannend.

Wir suchen Menschen, die mit uns anpacken und wachsen wollen. Als Familienunternehmen ziehen wir gemeinsam an einem Strang und in dieselbe Richtung. Wenn du Lust auf einen tollen Job im Gebäudemanagement hast, freuen wir uns sehr auf deine Bewerbung

  • Lust darauf, neue Software, Prozesse und Standards nicht nur mitzudenken, sondern aktiv mit aufzubauen

  • eine strukturierte, zuverlässige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, Kollegen bei digitalen Themen verständlich zu unterstützen

  • Offenheit für ein dynamisches, wachsendes Umfeld, in dem sich Prozesse und Strukturen weiterentwickeln

  • Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und den Anspruch, Dinge besser zu machen

jobs.title: Senior Paid Social Manager
jobs.excerpt: Launch With Us - Senior Paid Social ManagerFunction: Paid Social | Meta & TikTok Advertising | Performance Marketing Responsibility: Drive profitable growth across a portfolio of DTC brands through strategic paid social leadership, client management, and mentoring Paid Social Managers.
jobs.description:
Launch With Us - Senior Paid Social Manager

Function: Paid Social | Meta & TikTok Advertising | Performance Marketing
Responsibility: Drive profitable growth across a portfolio of DTC brands through strategic paid social leadership, client management, and mentoring Paid Social Managers.
Reports to: Paid Social Lead
KPI’s: New Customer Growth, MER, Client Retention
Location: Remote First
Compensation: £45,000 to £55,000

Overview:

At Launch With Us, we manage £25M+ in annual paid media across Meta, Google & TikTok for brands including Lucky Saint, Fem Fuelz, Butter & Crust, Four Five and Pets Pureset, taking them from £2-3M in revenue through £8M, £9M, £10M and beyond.

Creative and media sit on one team at Launch With Us, not two agencies bolted together and coordinated after the fact. Performance Media, Performance Creative, Paid Search and Growth Strategy all report into the same room, which is why we're ranked the UK's number one Independent Meta Agency Group by Meta, and part of the wider Soar Group.

As part of one of the UK’s leading independent agency groups, we operate with speed, autonomy, and a high level of ownership. There’s no red tape- just fast decision-making and the ability to move quickly. We’re also deeply AI-forward in how we think and operate, constantly evolving how we drive performance and efficiency for our brands.

Our team has quickly grown to 20+ operators after 120% YoY growth for the past 2 years. We offer remote-first working with access to our London office based in Camden, where all agencies in the group live! Culture, training, and professional development are at the heart of who we are, offering you structured training and clear progression into higher seats across the agency.

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Paid Social Manager, you will own strategy and performance across a portfolio of DTC eCommerce brands. You will work directly with founders and senior stakeholders to identify growth opportunities, improve account performance, and drive client outcomes. You will also mentor Paid Social Managers & Media Buyers, helping raise execution standards across the business.

You deeply understand the core levers that drive eCommerce growth: offer, conversion, creative, and distribution. You know how to diagnose performance challenges quickly, uncover opportunities others miss, and confidently present solutions that founders and commercial leaders trust and act on.

Working closely with Media Buyers, Paid Social Managers, and Creative teams, you'll identify growth opportunities, remove performance bottlenecks, and ensure strategy translates into measurable commercial outcomes - with the agency's specialist creative, media and data resource sitting behind you rather than in front of you.

The Brands Behind this Role:

You will be trusted with a small number of high-growth eCommerce brands, not a long list managed at arm's length. For confidentiality, specific accounts are not named ahead of interview, but the following reflect the calibre and scale you will be operating at, drawn from our own case study portfolio:

  • A premium, couture-finish womenswear brand. Founder-led, product-first, built on a loyal existing customer base: the challenge was finding new customers profitably after a disappointing quarter, without diluting the premium positioning. Recent portfolio outcomes at this level: 69% net profit increase, 9x blended ROAS, spend scaled 148%.
  • A challenger eCommerce brand built from an established Amazon marketplace base. Proven product, proven logistics, no owned acquisition channel yet: the mandate was building a full DTC paid media engine from a standing start, against a 100% year-on-year growth target. Recent portfolio outcomes at this level: 135% revenue increase, 97% new customer revenue increase, 79% more new customer orders.
  • A seasonal, subscription-building home and lifestyle brand. Strong peak-trading performance, a new subscription product still finding its footing: the challenge was maximising Q4 without the business resetting every January. Recent portfolio outcomes at this level: 82% year-on-year growth, 101% increase in new customers, 130% increase in subscription revenue.

    This is the standard of outcome expected in this seat, and the standard you will be expected to own and repeat.

Requirements

Your Impact:

  • The growth forecast for every account in your portfolio is yours to set: the number each brand needs to hit, and the paid social plan built to reach it.
  • Diagnose the one constraint actually holding an account back, whether that is offer, creative, or the page traffic lands on, and fix that before anything else.
  • Build creative testing roadmaps that treat volume and iteration as a science, not a backlog, so accounts compound instead of plateauing.
  • Apply offer psychology and landing page testing as core levers, not afterthoughts: pricing, bundles, and page experience decide as much as the ad does.
  • Carry new customer growth, MER, and retention as commercial outcomes you are accountable for, not metrics passed upward for someone else to act on.
  • When account data points at a specific lever, act on it immediately rather than waiting for the next scheduled review.

Strategic Account Leadership

  • Take ownership of strategy and performance across a portfolio of DTC e-commerce brands, ensuring activity remains aligned with client objectives, commercial targets, and growth plans. You will be responsible for translating business goals into actionable paid social strategies that deliver measurable results.
  • Lead account planning by identifying opportunities to improve customer acquisition, increase efficiency, and scale profitable growth. You will regularly review account performance and proactively recommend new initiatives that support long-term success.
  • Develop and oversee testing roadmaps across audiences, creative, offers, landing pages, and campaign structures, ensuring accounts continue to evolve and improve over time.
  • Work closely with Growth Executives to ensure strategic recommendations are implemented effectively and that account activity remains aligned with wider business objectives.

Performance Analysis & Growth

  • Analyse performance across Meta, TikTok, Triple Whale, Shopify, and reporting platforms to identify trends, opportunities, and areas of concern. You will use data to make informed decisions and guide account strategy.
  • Monitor key growth metrics including ROAS, CAC, MER, NC-ROAS, and customer acquisition efficiency, ensuring accounts remain on track to achieve performance targets.
  • Identify underperforming areas quickly and develop recovery plans that address performance issues while maintaining client confidence.
  • Continuously seek opportunities to improve account performance through testing, optimisation, and strategic recommendations that contribute to sustainable growth.

Creative Performance Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Creative Strategists to ensure creative output is aligned with account objectives and informed by performance data.
  • Provide strategic feedback on messaging, hooks, formats, offers, and content themes, helping shape creative testing priorities and future campaigns.
  • Use consumer insights and campaign learnings to influence creative direction and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and customer acquisition performance.
  • Stay ahead of platform trends, creative developments, and emerging opportunities across Meta and TikTok, ensuring clients benefit from innovative approaches.

Ai & Operational Efficiency

  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, ideation, analysis, and strategic thinking.
  • Leverage AI to streamline workflows, improve output quality, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities where AI can unlock faster insight discovery or better decision-making.
  • Stay ahead of emerging AI tools and workflows relevant to performance marketing and growth strategy.

Client Leadership:

  • Act as the primary day-to-day strategic contact for assigned clients, building strong relationships through trust, reliability, and consistent performance.
  • Lead performance reviews, planning sessions, and strategy discussions with confidence, helping clients understand both short-term results and long-term opportunities.
  • Present recommendations clearly and commercially, ensuring clients understand the rationale behind decisions and the impact on business growth.
  • Drive client retention by delivering exceptional service, maintaining strong communication, and consistently demonstrating value.

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months):

  • During your first three months, you will become fully embedded within your client portfolio and establish yourself as a trusted strategic partner for both clients and internal teams.
  • You will develop a thorough understanding of client objectives, account performance, and growth opportunities, while confidently leading strategic discussions and performance reviews.
  • By the end of this period, you will be taking ownership of account strategy, contributing proactively to growth planning, and demonstrating strong leadership within your pod.
  • By six months, you will be driving measurable improvements across account performance, client retention, and commercial outcomes.
  • You will be recognised for your ability to identify growth opportunities, solve complex performance challenges, and provide strategic recommendations that influence client decision-making.
  • You will also be actively supporting the development of Paid Social Managers, helping improve both individual performance and overall team capability.

You’ll Thrive Here If You Have:

  • 3+ years of paid social experience within an agency or DTC e-commerce environment, with a proven track record of scaling brands through Meta and TikTok advertising.
  • Deep understanding of paid social strategy, customer acquisition, creative testing methodologies, and full-funnel growth planning.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect marketing performance to wider business objectives and growth outcomes.
  • Proven experience developing account strategies that improve customer acquisition efficiency, increase revenue, and drive sustainable growth.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities, with confidence using Triple Whale, Shopify, GA4, Meta, and TikTok reporting environments to identify opportunities and solve performance challenges.
  • Excellent client-facing communication skills, with the ability to confidently lead strategy discussions, performance reviews, and planning sessions.
  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or supporting the development of junior team members, helping elevate performance across the wider team.
  • Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and day-to-day execution.
  • Proactive, commercially minded, and comfortable taking ownership of performance outcomes.
  • Passionate about growth marketing, innovation, and helping both clients and colleagues achieve success.

Benefits

  • Join a fast-growing and ambitious company with a collaborative, people-first culture.
  • Benefit from a hybrid-first working model, with remote working and optional access to our London office for collaboration and team connection.
  • Enjoy 27 days of annual leave, plus Bank Holidays and your birthday off each year.
  • Work abroad for up to 30 days per year (T&Cs apply), giving you added flexibility and balance.
  • Benefit from a company pension scheme designed to support your long-term future.
  • Begin with a clear and structured employee progression roadmap designed to support your development from day one.
  • Access private health insurance after 6 months, helping you prioritise your wellbeing.
  • Receive life insurance cover alongside Smart Health wellbeing support services.
  • Benefit from a healthcare cash plan covering dental, optical, and physiotherapy support.
  • Follow a clear and structured progression plan designed to support your professional growth and career development.
  • Annual pay reviews, supported by quarterly performance evaluations and structured progression plans.
  • Enjoy monthly incentives and a Kudos reward scheme that recognises and celebrates great work.
  • Be rewarded through a Christmas performance bonus scheme.
  • Access ongoing training and personal development opportunities to continue building your skills and expertise.

    We're not seeking the conventional choice. We're looking for the creative strategist who will shape the future of performance-driven creative and who thrives on the responsibility of delivering results.If you're ready to take ownership of strategic creative excellence and drive measurable impact at scale, we want to hear from you.

    As part of our hiring process, we may also introduce your profile to other relevant opportunities through our HAYRA platform — a curated network of leading e-commerce brands. This is designed to increase your chances of finding the right role, without needing to apply multiple times. If you would prefer to be considered for this role only, you can let us know at any stage.”

Sales Executive Job Description

This is a fully-remote position. We just want the best, wherever you are.

Your Goals

You will start by receiving some leads from Popcorn Growth, and converting these clients with an entry level service (billing ~$50,000 over 6 months) that allows our clients to understand our unique proposition. Once you have built a network of clients, you are expected to source your own leads.

For reference, because of our strong value proposition, our standard campaigns take about [1 to 5 calls] to convert, and have a sales lead time of about 3 to 4 months.

Will you succeed in this role?

People who excel in our environment are people who are fast, independent learners who can pick up concepts quickly.

Our training consists of:

Keys to success:

  • We reward performance, not hours worked, not tenure.
