Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief

Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.

CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. Our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who help members get to fantastic experts for their care and help them through the thousands of other problems that arise across the cancer journey.

Join us to serve cancer patients in their hour of need.

The “VP of Engineering” Role

Role and Team:

As VP of Engineering, you’ll join CancerNavigator at a pivotal stage of growth and have the opportunity to shape what our engineering function becomes. Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll initially operate as a highly hands-on technical leader—setting the technical strategy, defining the roadmap, and building alongside the team. Over time, you’ll take on leadership of our existing technical resources and build out the engineering organization needed to support our next stage of scale.

This is not a role where you’ll inherit a mature engineering organization or a predefined roadmap. You’ll work closely with leaders across the business to understand how our service operates today, identify the highest-impact opportunities for technology, and determine what we should build, buy, automate, or redesign.

Daily Work:

This is a highly entrepreneurial, hands-on leadership role. You’ll have significant autonomy to shape both what we build and how engineering operates at CancerNavigator. You will:

  • Partner with our CEO and functional leaders to set the technical strategy and roadmap for the business.
  • Identify the highest-impact opportunities to use technology and AI to help our team serve more patients at scale.
  • Design and build foundational systems, particularly in the early stages of the role.
  • Lead the development of tools across patient navigation, communication, research, and healthcare data processing.
  • Grow and lead our engineering function, establishing the team, infrastructure, and practices we’ll need for our next stage of growth.

The Requirements

  • Engineering leadership experience, ideally in a VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar role within a health tech company.
  • Strong experience building technology in healthcare, with a deep understanding of HIPAA and the security, privacy, and data considerations that come with handling sensitive health information.
  • A track record of taking complex technical problems from strategy through architecture and hands-on execution.
  • Experience building and scaling technology for a tech-enabled service or other operationally complex business.
  • Experience with modern data infrastructure and cloud-based systems, with familiarity in Python and SQL.
  • Experience applying AI to automate back-end workflows, augment human operations, and build real-world products.
  • An entrepreneurial, hands-on approach—you’re comfortable setting the strategy, operating with ambiguity, and rolling up your sleeves to build.

Strongly preferred: Experience working with medical claims, prior authorization, or other complex healthcare data.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary and stock option package
  • Performance-based incentive compensation
  • Remote-first work; live where you want within the U.S.
  • All-company on-sites 2-3 times per year
  • Medical and Dental Insurance (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
  • Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy-up coverage)
  • Unlimited PTO

Our Culture & Values, In Brief

We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer – serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.

We have three company values, which guide our company:

  1. Patients first, always: In everything we do, we put the cancer patient (and their families) first; we exist to serve them in their most urgent moments.
  2. Respect for our responsibility: We strive, as a team, to respect the gravity of the responsibility we bear to patients, always acting and producing in a way that is worthy of the trust they have placed in us.
  3. Kindness to and respect for others: We treat our teammates well, no exceptions. We are one team.

At CancerNavigator, we believe a well-rounded and diverse team is a key to our success. We never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.

Mexico (Remote)

This scope of work applies to Team A, supporting one or more outpatient mental health center clients. The Medical Biller & Coder is responsible for executing accurate, compliant, and timely billing and coding services to support end-to-end revenue cycle operations.

SUMMARY OF CONTRACT SCOPE

The Medical Biller & Coder provides medical billing and coding services for outpatient mental health center clients. This includes translating clinical documentation into accurate diagnosis and procedure codes, entering charges, submitting claims, correcting errors, and supporting accounts receivable workflows.

All services are performed under the functional oversight and quality review of the Medical Billing & Coding Analyst 1 (Team Lead – Team A) and are a critical component of the Revenue Cycle Management process.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking contract writers to develop Christ-centered Bible studies. These studies should offer in-depth theology readers can truly understand—grounded in careful exegesis and a Christ-centered hermeneutic—while remaining accessible to serious lay readers and church groups. Our aim is not merely to inform but to cultivate spiritual transformation, helping readers experience the grace of Jesus and grow in faithful obedience.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a complete Bible study in Daily Grace's Bible study format
  • Write with theological depth that remains clear and understandable
  • Intentionally guide readers toward spiritual formation and lived obedience
  • Maintain an ecumenical tone when engaging theological issues and interpretive differences
  • Collaborate with the editorial team through multiple rounds of review and revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with the organization’s doctrinal commitment

Qualifications

  • Master of Divinity (M.Div.) or another advanced theological degree strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated competency in biblical exegesis
  • A clearly articulated Christ-centered hermeneutic
  • Experience writing or teaching Bible studies for lay audiences
  • Ability to communicate complex theological ideas with clarity and pastoral sensitivity
  • Comfortable collaborating within a team-based editorial process
  • Willingness to receive and implement substantive feedback

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish Bible studies—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important: Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

Please submit all materials in a single document and include:

1. Suggested title and subtitle.

2. Controlling idea of the Bible study: In one sentence, state the central theological message of the biblical text as this study will present it, and the transformation it aims to produce in the reader.
3. A summary of resources that will be used and how they will inform your theological approach: Describe the key sources that will inform your interpretation and application of this biblical text, including commentaries or theological works, and explain how these sources shape your approach and serve the intended reader.
4. A list of potential theological issues and interpretive issues: Provide a brief list of potential theological tensions, debated interpretive issues, or common application pitfalls that arise from this biblical text, and explain how you plan to address them faithfully and in accordance with TDGC’s ecumenical approach.

5. Target audience description: Explain who is this Bible study written for and why it matters to them.

6. Comparable titles: Include 2–3 comparable Bible studies and explain how this study is distinct from each one.

7. Author bio: Explain what makes you uniquely qualified to write this book.

8. Complete Bible study outline: For each day of the study, please include the passage to be studied and a one sentence summary of the the main idea of the passage. It should be clear how the outline supports the controlling idea. Except for year-long Bible studies, each week of the study should contain 5 days of study content and two rest days.
9. Three complete sample Bible study days: Please include at least three sample days of the study. Each day should provide 750–1000 words of commentary on one passage of Scripture. The commentary should be engaging, informational, Christ-centered, and should offer specific real-life points of application. It should also include two questions for reflection and application and one prayer prompt.
10. Front and back matter: describe any supplemental material the Bible study will include such as maps, charts, illustrations, timelines, etc.

11. Timeline and specifications: include current manuscript status (work in progress, complete, etc.), anticipated manuscript delivery date, and any other information that is relevant to provide.

Bible Study Topics of Particular Interest

We are especially interested in proposals in the following categories:

Expositional Studies

  • Leviticus
  • Deuteronomy
  • Ezra
  • Proverbs
  • Song of Songs
  • Jeremiah
  • Matthew
  • 1 & 2 Corinthians (one cohesive study covering both books)
  • 1 & 2 Timothy

Topical Exposition Studies

  • Forgiveness
  • Creating and Living a Rule of Life
  • Addressing Current Cultural Issues
  • God’s Goodness
  • Developing Biblical Discernment
  • Marriage

Studies to Guide Readers Through Church Calendar Seasons

  • Lent
  • Advent

Year-Long Studies

  • 52-Week Studies
  • 365-Day Studies

jobs.description:
Job Title: Director, Major Gifts

Organizational Unit: Development

Reports To: Chief Development Officer

Supervises: Mid-level Giving & Prospecting Officer

Location: Equality Now is a remote organization. This position may be based in Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Virginia, or Washington, D.C., with a strong preference for candidates based in New York.

MISSION OBJECTIVE:

The Director, Major Gifts plays a pivotal role in advancing Equality Now’s global mission by leading and growing a major gifts portfolio, including gala sponsorships, mid-level giving and donor engagement. In partnership with the Chief Development Officer and Chief Executive Officer, the Director translates Equality Now’s development strategy into actionable fundraising plans, strengthens donor pipelines and systems, and cultivates meaningful relationships with individuals, family foundations, and philanthropic networks.This role spans strategy, donor cultivation and stewardship, portfolio management, events, executive engagement, and team leadership, and collaborates closely with Annual Giving & Development Operations functions. It requires an experienced fundraising leader with sound judgment, strong relationship-management skills, cross-cultural fluency, and the ability to translate Equality Now’s complex legal and programmatic work into compelling opportunities for philanthropic investment.

The Director will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen Equality Now’s Individual and Major Giving program during an important period of organizational growth. The successful candidate must be comfortable building systems, navigating complexity, inspiring donors and colleagues, and building the capacity of supervisee(s) and other junior staff focused on securing sustainable revenue to advance legal and systemic change for women and girls worldwide.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The following provides a general outline of the role. It is not exhaustive, and responsibilities may evolve at the discretion of the CDO based on organizational needs and priorities.

Purpose: Innovate for Mission Expansion

  • Serve as the senior lead for operationalizing the Individual & Major Giving strategy, translating our 2026-2030 development strategy into actionable plans, systems, and donor pathways across the full Individual Giving portfolio.
  • Drive the execution and refinement of Equality Now’s high-touch major donor growth strategy, including implementing a network-mapping approach, strengthening Advisory Board and Ambassador engagement, building individualized strategies for UHNW, and designing innovative donor/prospect engagement initiatives (eg-salons, donor cohorts, donor journeys, in-kind/volunteer opportunities for mission impact)
  • Partner with the CEO and CDO to support high-value donor/prospect cultivation and shape donor-facing opportunities aligned with organizational priorities, advising on donor motivations, portfolio insights, and potential engagement opportunities.
  • Provide strategic leadership to align all tiers of individual giving—major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level, and annual giving—ensuring cohesive messaging, clear donor journeys, and seamless handoffs between donor segments.
  • Lead maintenance and continuous improvement of pipeline development and tracking practices, including
    donor qualification, engagement strategies, moves management, and standardized systems that enhance efficiency, clarity, and visibility across the portfolio.
  • Lead/guide the development of donor-facing cases for support, investment opportunities, and strategic offerings, ensuring they reflect Equality Now’s mission, program vision, and funder-aligned messaging.

Engagement: Advocate

  • Manage a portfolio of high-value donors and prospects, cultivating deep, trust-based relationships with individuals and family foundations capable of $10,000–$250,000+ giving, while identifying opportunities and supporting leadership-level engagement.
  • Support CEO and CDO engagement with top-tier donors and prospects, preparing strategic briefings, donor intelligence, outreach recommendations, follow-up plans, and bespoke cultivation opportunities.
  • Oversee and elevate the mid-level donor program, ensuring a compelling donor journey that supports upgrades and helps to surface and convert major donor prospects.
  • Engage and activate Advisory Board members and other supporters and ambassadors, partnering with them to leverage networks, cultivate prospective donors, support events, and build community around Equality Now.
  • Serve as an external ambassador for Equality Now, representing the mission with fluency in global women’s rights and human rights–cultivating relationships and expanding networks in philanthropic and peer spaces.
  • Ensure donor experiences reflect mission-driven, community-centered engagement, including opportunities to meet international staff, join learning conversations, attend cultivation events, and participate in curated donor experiences.
  • Strengthen departmental and cross-departmental collaboration, to ensure donor messaging is programmatically accurate, compelling, and aligned with organizational impact narratives, and that the development program gains efficiencies and effectiveness through collaboration across corporate, institutional and individual giving.

Delivery: Define Project Cycle

  • Lead the operational management of the entire Major & Mid-levelGiving portfolio, overseeing processes, timelines, deliverables, and performance standards across major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level giving, and annual giving.
  • Implement and oversee strong systems for donor/prospect planning and tracking, including moves management, portfolio assignment, forecasting, and performance analytics, ensuring leadership always has clear visibility into pipeline health.
  • Partner with the Manager, Annual Fund & Development Operations, to ensure excellence in development operations, data integrity, analytics, and annual fund growth strategies.
  • Contribute to the planning and execution of high-impact donor events with Comms & Development colleagues, including the gala, cultivation salons, and community-building convenings, ensuring events advance the 2026-2030 development strategy and build momentum for donor/prospect engagement and pipeline development.
  • Develop individualized donor strategies and annual engagement plans, ensuring they are tailored to the donors’ interests, mission-centered, and coordinated with leadership involvement and organizational priorities and opportunities.
  • Produce high-quality donor communications and materials, partnering with Programs and Communications to prepare proposals, impact updates, donor briefings and reports, strategic correspondence, and leadership-level messaging.
  • Ensure accurate reporting, analytics, and revenue projections, synthesizing donor engagement metrics, portfolio movement, and pipeline health to support leadership decision-making and organizational planning.
  • Drive continuous learning and adaptive planning, integrating donor insights, event performance, campaign outcomes, and Strategic Plan benchmarks into ongoing improvements to Major Giving and Mid-level gift operations.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position supervises staff and is responsible for providing leadership, guidance, development, and performance management. Responsibilities may evolve based on organizational needs.

Leadership and Team Management

  • Provide clear direction, priorities, and performance expectations to direct reports.
  • Hold regular check-ins, monitor performance, provide timely feedback, and support professional growth.
  • Foster an inclusive, accountable, transparent, and high-performing team culture.
  • Address operational and personnel issues promptly, fairly, and in coordination with People & Culture when appropriate.

Performance and Development

  • Conduct performance reviews and identify individual and team development needs.
  • Coach and mentor staff to strengthen fundraising, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
  • Promote cross-functional learning and knowledge sharing.

Operations and Workflow

  • Manage workflows, priorities, workloads, leave, and coverage to maintain operational continuity.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and outcomes against agreed objectives.
  • Hold regular team meetings to communicate priorities, share updates, and address challenges.

Compliance and Collaboration

  • Ensure adherence to organizational policies, ethical standards, safeguarding requirements, and applicable laws.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across departments and leadership.
  • Model Equality Now’s values of integrity and accountability, inclusiveness, resilience, and empathy.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS & TARGET SKILLS PROFILE:
The Director will be thoroughly committed to Equality Now’s mission. The position requires deep subject-matter expertise, visionary leadership, and functional integration capacity. Specific requirements include:

Substantive Knowledge

  • Deep expertise in major gift fundraising, high-touch donor engagement strategies, and best practice moves management, ideally in a global nonprofit setting, with demonstrated success in securing 5–7 figure gifts from individuals and family foundations
  • Strong understanding or direct experience in event fundraising, high-touch donor engagement and strengthening development operations and workflows.
  • Familiarity with global human rights, women’s rights and gender equality funding landscapes (highly desirable). Understanding of legal, advocacy and movement building approaches is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop staff.


Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Spanish, French, or Arabic is a plus.
  • Adept at fostering cross-cultural collaboration and cultivating trust-based relationships consistent with the mission and values of Equality Now.
  • Exceptional donor relationship management and communication skills, with a demonstrated aptitude for translating complex legal, financial, and programmatic concepts into compelling, polished, audience-specific decks, proposals and cases for support.
  • Strong listening, verbal and interpersonal skills to engage professionally and effectively with HNW donors, senior leadership, partners, and staff across geographies and cultures.
  • Adept at facilitating cross-functional collaboration, ensuring clarity, transparency, and strategic alignment between Development, Programs, and Finance, while fostering trust, accountability, and mutual respect across diverse and dispersed teams.


Execution Skills

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with a focus on strategic delivery and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to recruit, mentor, and manage staff, fellows, and consultants, fostering high-performing, accountable teams, while modeling inclusive leadership, ensuring all voices are heard, valued, and meaningfully integrated into decision-making processes.
  • Strategic and creative thinker with a record of translating vision into measurable outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills with a track record of meeting deadlines and producing high-quality deliverables in fast-paced environments.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and adaptable, with experience in database management (Raiser’s Edge NXT or equivalent).
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally and domestically, sometimes on short notice, to support regional teams, engage with partners, and represent Equality Now.

Targeted Specialized Knowledge

  • Bachelor's degree required, Master’s degree, Continuing Education or significant professional experience in relevant fields is highly desired (e.g., International Relations, Nonprofit Management, Public Policy, Law, Human Rights, CFRE certification, etc)
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible fundraising experience, including substantial, independent donor-facing work and staff/program management responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated success working in a global human rights, gender equality, or related international NGO context, with proven ability to navigate diverse and complex organizations is preferred.

COMPENSATION:

At Equality Now, our compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to advancing the human rights of women and girls through lasting legal and systemic change. We approach pay holistically, recognizing base salary as one part of a broader total rewards package designed to support employee wellbeing, growth, and long-term engagement.

  • Base Salary Range: $120,000–$140,000 USD

The final offer will be determined based on several factors, including geographic location, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, qualifications, and internal equity. Equality Now also provides a comprehensive total rewards package, including health and retirement benefits, generous leave, and professional development opportunities.

HOW TO APPLY:

Applicants must submit a resume or CV and a cover letter. Incomplete applications will not be considered. The application period will close at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on September 30, 2026. Due to the anticipated volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employees are selected based on their qualifications and ability, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, language, political or other opinion, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, pregnancy, mental status, HIV status, age, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. We welcome and value all forms of diversity.

jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

A Software Architect exemplifies technical expertise and excellence at NPR. Working alongside engineering leadership and cross-functional discipline teams, you will guide strategic technology decisions, design scalable solutions, and build robust pipelines, services, and tools that support NPR and our Member Station Network.

In this role, you will lead technology strategy across our most complex engineering initiatives—those impacting multiple product lines, distributed systems, and mobile platforms simultaneously. Responsible for end-to-end architecture from platform services to client applications and downstream data pipelines, you will balance system performance, developer velocity, data privacy, and cost-efficiency to deliver exceptional public media experiences at scale.

Responsibilities

Architectural Strategy & System Design

  1. Architect Unified Mobile & Cross-Platform Systems: Define and implement shared architectural patterns and modular design systems across native iOS and Android codebases and cross-platform integrations to maximize code reuse and development velocity.
  2. Design Scalable Personalization & Delivery Pipelines: Lead platform-to-client architecture for personalized content delivery, supporting high-traffic, localized media experiences across owned digital properties and member station networks.
  3. Drive Technology Standards & Evaluation: Conduct technical evaluations for custom builds versus vendor solutions; introduce modern technologies and establish architectural standards across divisions.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Governance

  1. Lead Multi-Team Engineering Initiatives: Provide technical oversight and direction across cross-divisional product roadmaps, project proposals, and OKR planning cycles for multi-team initiatives.
  2. Establish Quality & Code Governance: Conduct architectural proposals and code reviews, providing substantive feedback on system designs, security protocols, workflows, and peer-written software.
  3. Integrate Compliance & Cost Controls: Architect solutions with explicit focus on privacy compliance (GDPR/CPRA), security standards, CDN caching strategies, and cloud cost optimization frameworks.

Operational Excellence & Mentorship

  1. Support Deployment & Operational Resilience: Participate in automated deployments across QA, UAT, and production environments; join the developer on-call rotation to diagnose and resolve critical incidents.
  2. Contribute High-Quality Code: Author documented, resilient code and reusable core libraries aligned with department standards and sprint commitments.
  3. Foster Technical Mentorship & Team Growth: Assist in onboarding, training, and interviewing software engineering staff, advocating for efficient agile processes and inclusive team practices.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Multi-Team System Architecture: 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including demonstrated success designing and leading technical architecture for complex, multi-team platform environments.
  • Native Mobile Engineering Expertise: Deep technical proficiency in native mobile architecture (iOS and Android) using languages such as Swift, Kotlin, Java, or Objective-C.
  • Scalable Platform & API Design: Proven track record designing high-traffic, resilient distributed systems, RESTful/GraphQL APIs, and client-server integration patterns.
  • Media Delivery & Infrastructure: Practical experience architecting media playback, streaming protocols, CDN configurations, and cloud infrastructure ecosystems (e.g., AWS or GCP).
  • Data Privacy & Cost Optimization: Hands-on experience integrating data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CPRA) alongside cloud cost optimization frameworks in high-availability environments.
  • CI/CD & Quality Automation: Demonstrated experience with modern version control systems (Git), continuous integration pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Polyglot Backend Systems: Familiarity with modern backend languages such as Go or PHP in event-driven or microservice architectures.
  • Advanced Caching & Open Source: Experience optimizing edge media caches, working with relational databases/SQL, or contributing to open-source software initiatives.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Cross-Functional Technical Governance: Ability to translate complex business and product requirements into clear, practical architectural designs accepted across multiple engineering teams.
  • Technical Mentorship & Code Quality Advocacy: Strong commitment to promoting engineering best practices, conducting empathetic code reviews, and elevating overall code quality.
  • Operational Resilience & Diagnostic Vision: Ability to systematically isolate, diagnose, and resolve production incidents under high-urgency conditions during on-call rotation.
  • Structured Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to present software architecture proposals, trade-offs, and technical roadmaps to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Mission-Driven Innovation: Passion for leveraging modern technology to advance public media, accessibility, and audience engagement.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent technical architecture capability.

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $184,758.33 - $205,933.12 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

jobs.description:
Sidekick, an injury rehab products company, is running a fully virtual clinical study of a balance-training device for people recovering from ankle sprains. About 80 participants across Canada will complete a 28-day at-home program with virtual check-ins.

You'll be the participant's main point of contact. You will screen and enroll participants, run virtual study visits by video, guide them through standardized functional assessments, monitor daily symptom diaries and follow up on missed entries, and record data in the electronic data capture system according to protocol. You'll be trained on all assessments by the study's physiotherapist investigator and work alongside a clinical trial consultant on protocol compliance.

  • Graduate degree (or in progress) in a health-related field: physiotherapy, kinesiology, nursing, public health, rehabilitation science, or similar
  • Experience with human-subject research, ideally in a coordinator or RA role
  • Current GCP certification, or willingness to complete it before start
  • Comfortable running structured video sessions with participants and keeping meticulous records
  • Available 20–25 hours per week, with some flexibility for participant scheduling (evenings/weekends)
  • Based in Canada

Benefits

  • $30/hour
  • Fully remote, set your own hours within participant availability
  • Hands-on clinical trial experience from enrolment through study close, on a study intended for peer-reviewed publication
  • Training on standardized functional assessments from a practicing physiotherapist
  • Small team with direct access to the investigator and study sponsor

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST

Allied Roofing Partners

Remote | Full-Time | Hourly

$18.00–$22.00 per hour, based on experience

ABOUT THE ROLE

A Customer Experience (CX) Specialist is often the first person a homeowner talks to—whether they've called, filled out a web form, or clicked a social ad.

The CX Specialist role is designed to make sure customers hear back in minutes, not hours. CX will also help existing customers with questions and/or basic information as needed.

This role blends customer service and appointment setting. You'll work from proven scripts and playbooks while bringing real listening and judgment to every call.

You'll start by supporting Capstone Roofing, with room to grow into other brands and tools as our CX team expands.

Our goal is simple: Homeowners feel supported, not processed.

POSITION DETAILS

  • Location: Remote – United States(preferred Pst TIme)

• Employment Type: Full-Time, Hourly

  • Compensation: $18.00–$22.00 per hour, based on experience
    • Schedule: Daytime business hours, with evening and Saturday coverage during peak season
    • Overtime available
    • Reports to: Assistant Director, Customer Experience

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Outbound – Appointment Setting & Recovery

  • Call back homeowners who reached out but haven't booked and get them scheduled.
    • Work our recovery list of missed calls and unworked web leads. These are a high priority because they are leads we've already paid for.
    • When time allows, re-engage past quotes, older estimates, and past customers to help fill the calendar further out.

Inbound Customer Experience

  • Answer inbound calls from homeowners requesting to book an inspection or estimate.
    • Assist existing customers with job-related or basic questions.
    • Respond to new website and social media leads within minutes.

• Log every interaction in the CRM.

  • Transfer billing questions finance team.

Expectations

  • Follow our calling cadence, scripts, and playbooks while adapting with good judgment when a situation calls for it.
    • Meet daily and weekly targets for response speed, contact rate, and appointments booked.
    • Provide a professional, friendly, and helpful experience during every customer interaction.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

  • Phone-based customer service, appointment setting, inside sales, or call-center experience, including experience working with scripts or playbooks.
    • Clear, confident, and friendly phone presence.

• Persistent without being pushy.

  • Empathy, patience, and quick thinking with the ability to respond thoughtfully rather than react.
    • Strong comfort with technology and the ability to learn and move between a CRM, dialer or softphone, and other tools as they evolve.
    • Self-discipline and the ability to work productively from home.
    • Quiet, professional home workspace with reliable high-speed internet.
    • Coachable and goal-driven mindset.
    • Authorization to work in the United States.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in roofing, home services, or another trades or contractor business.

• Bilingual with conversational Spanish.

  • Previous lead-recovery calling experience.

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

Weeks 1–2

  • Learn Capstone's scripts and systems.

• Shadow live calls.

  • Begin handling inbound calls with support.

By Day 30

  • Handle inbound calls independently.

• Begin working the recovery list.

By Day 90

  • Consistently meet contact-rate and appointment-setting targets across inbound, recovery, and re-engagement work.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

    • Medical insurance and company sponsored life insurance

• Dental insurance

• Vision insurance• 401(k)

  • Paid time off
    • Paid holidays

• Equipment and software provided

If you've worked somewhere the platform rules genuinely bite, you'll know exactly what we mean.

jobs.excerpt: 💻 Kodland HakkındaKodland, 5–17 yaş arası çocuklara programlama, matematik, dijital tasarım ve teknoloji becerileri kazandıran uluslararası bir online eğitim platformudur.
jobs.description:
💻 Kodland Hakkında

Kodland, 5–17 yaş arası çocuklara programlama, matematik, dijital tasarım ve teknoloji becerileri kazandıran uluslararası bir online eğitim platformudur.

Canlı online derslerimizde Python, Roblox, Minecraft, Dijital Yaratıcılık ve benzeri modern alanları proje tabanlı bir öğrenme yaklaşımıyla sunuyoruz.

Türkiye ekibimize katılacak, çocuklar ve velilerle birebir online deneme dersleri gerçekleştirecek Online Eğitim ve Satış Danışmanları (TCM) arıyoruz.

Bu pozisyon klasik bir öğretmenlik rolü değildir. Eğitim danışmanlığı, güçlü iletişim ve sonuç odaklı satışın birleştiği bir çalışma modelidir.

🎯 Bu rolde ne yapacaksın?

Zoom üzerinden çocuk ve en az bir velinin katıldığı, yaklaşık 60 dakikalık online deneme dersleri gerçekleştireceksin.

Görüşme boyunca:

  • Çocuk ve veliyle güvene dayalı iletişim kuracak,

  • Çocuğun ilgi alanlarını, hedeflerini ve eğitim ihtiyaçlarını anlayacak,

  • Hazır Kodland materyalleriyle kısa bir uygulamalı aktivite yönetecek,

  • Gözlemlerine göre en uygun kursu ve öğrenme modelini önerecek,

  • Velilerin sorularını yanıtlayacak ve tereddütlerini profesyonel şekilde ele alacak,

  • Uygun ailelerde kayıt, fiyatlandırma ve ödeme sürecini sonuçlandırmaya odaklanacaksın.

Kendi müşterini veya öğrencini bulman beklenmez. Görüşmeler, önceden belirlediğin çalışma programına göre Kodland tarafından planlanır.

Hazır ders yapısı, materyaller, eğitim ve ekip desteği sağlanır. Senden beklenen; görüşmeyi aktif şekilde yönetmen, ailelerin ihtiyaçlarını doğru anlaman, Kodland programlarının değerini net şekilde göstermen ve satış fırsatlarını sonuca ulaştırmandır.

🕒 Çalışma Modeli

Bu rol tamamen uzaktan ve freelance çalışma modeliyle yürütülür.

  • Haftada 5 gün

  • Haftada minimum 20–25 saat uygunluk

  • Hafta içi çalışma aralığı: 13.00–22.00

  • Hafta sonu çalışma aralığı: 10.00–22.00

Çalışma saatlerini bu zaman aralıkları içerisinde planlayabilirsin. Ailelerin görüşmeleri açtığın saatlere göre oluşturulduğu için programına düzenli ve tutarlı şekilde bağlı kalman beklenir.

Genellikle bir hafta içi ve bir hafta sonu günü izin olarak seçilebilir.

💰 Kazanç Modeli

Bu pozisyonda toplam kazanç aşağıdaki bileşenlerden oluşur:

  • Sabit ücret

  • Satış komisyonları

  • Performans primleri

Haftada yaklaşık 20–25 saat çalışan ekip üyeleri genellikle aylık 30.000–50.000 TL aralığında kazanç elde eder.

Güçlü ve istikrarlı satış performansı gösteren ekip üyeleri ise 70.000 TL ve üzeri kazanca ulaşabilir.

Toplam kazanç; çalışma yoğunluğuna, gerçekleştirilen görüşme sayısına, satış performansına ve kıdem seviyesine göre değişir. Sabit ücret ve toplam kazanç potansiyeli, Kodland’deki kıdemin ve performansın geliştikçe artabilir.

Belirtilen tutarlar garanti gelir değil, mevcut ekip performansına dayalı kazanç aralıklarıdır.

🧭 Eğitim ve İşe Alım Süreci

Başarılı adaylar gerçek ailelerle görüşmeye başlamadan önce yapılandırılmış bir eğitim ve değerlendirme sürecinden geçer.

Süreç genel olarak:

  1. Başvurunun değerlendirilmesi

  2. Kısa online işe alım görüşmesi

  3. Bireysel çalışmalar ve canlı eğitim webinarları

  4. Pratik ve role-play oturumları

  5. Simüle deneme dersi değerlendirmesi

  6. Sözleşme, sistem erişimleri ve adaptasyon süreci

adımlarından oluşur.

Başvurudan ilk gerçek deneme dersine kadar geçen süre, eğitim planına ve adayın katılım hızına bağlı olarak yaklaşık iki haftadır.

🚀 Kodland Sana Ne Sunuyor?

  • Tamamen uzaktan çalışma

  • Sabit ücret, komisyon ve performans primleri

  • Hazır ders ve satış materyalleri

  • Kapsamlı eğitim ve adaptasyon süreci

  • Trainer, Team Leader ve ekip desteği

  • Uluslararası bir EdTech şirketinde deneyim

  • Satış, iletişim ve eğitim alanlarında gelişim fırsatı

  • Çocukların gelecekte kullanacağı beceriler kazanmasına katkı sağlayan anlamlı bir ürün

Requirements

✅ Zorunlu Gereksinimler

  • Kendine ait, güvenilir bir laptop veya masaüstü bilgisayar

  • Çalışır durumda kamera ve mikrofon

  • Zoom görüşmelerini kesintisiz gerçekleştirebilecek stabil internet bağlantısı

  • Kamera açık çalışmaya uygun, sessiz ve profesyonel bir çalışma ortamı

  • Haftada minimum 20–25 saat düzenli uygunluk

  • Hafta içi öğleden sonra ve akşam saatlerinde çalışabilme

  • Hafta sonunun en az bir gününde uygunluk gösterebilme

  • Türkçeyi akıcı, net ve güven veren şekilde kullanabilme

  • Çocuklarla ve yetişkinlerle rahat iletişim kurabilme

  • Online görüşmelerde enerjik ve profesyonel bir duruş sergileyebilme

  • Satış yapmaya, fiyat konuşmaya ve kayıt kararını yönetmeye açık olma

  • Hedef ve performans odaklı çalışabilme

  • Uzaktan çalışma düzeninde zamanını disiplinli şekilde yönetebilme

  • Bu rolü ana çalışma düzeni olarak sürdürebilme

🌟 Avantaj Sağlayacak Deneyimler

Aşağıdaki alanlardan birinde deneyim sahibi olman avantaj sağlar:

  • Satış veya danışmanlık

  • Müşteri hizmetleri veya çağrı merkezi

  • Eğitim, özel ders veya koçluk

  • Çocuklar ya da velilerle birebir iletişim

  • Uzaktan çalışma

  • CRM veya benzeri takip sistemleri

Bu deneyimlere sahip olman zorunlu değildir. Güçlü iletişim becerilerine, satış motivasyonuna ve öğrenme isteğine sahip adaylar da değerlendirilir.

🎯 Bu Rol Sana Uygun Olabilir, Eğer:

  • İnsanlarla konuşmayı ve ihtiyaçlarını anlamayı seviyorsan,

  • Çocuklarla iletişim kurmaktan keyif alıyorsan,

  • Satış ve performans sorumluluğu seni motive ediyorsa,

  • İtirazların satış sürecinin doğal bir parçası olduğunu biliyorsan,

  • Düzenli takip yapmanın sonuç almak için gerekli olduğunun farkındaysan,

  • Geri bildirime ve gelişime açıksan,

  • Çalışma programına istikrarlı şekilde bağlı kalabiliyorsan.

⚠️ Bu Rol Sana Uygun Olmayabilir, Eğer:

  • Yalnızca 09.00–17.00 saatleri arasında çalışabileceğin bir rol arıyorsan,

  • Akşam veya hafta sonu çalışmak istemiyorsan,

  • Satış yapma ya da fiyat konuşma konusunda rahat değilsen,

  • Kamera açık şekilde çalışmak istemiyorsan,

  • Performansının ölçüldüğü bir çalışma modeli sana uygun değilse,

  • Çocuklar ve velilerle birebir iletişim kurmak istemiyorsan.

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

Norbert is building autonomous robots that deliver healthcare.

Our AI sensing platform mounts on mobile robots and does the work of a care team member—rounding on patients, capturing vitals without contact (FDA-cleared for pulse and respiratory rate, more in the pipeline), running assessments, documenting to the EMR, and escalating when something's wrong.   • Ability to work independently, solve complex problems, and drive projects to completion

Bonus Points:

  • Talented, international team tackling meaningful problems in healthcare
  • Equity participation in the company's future

jobs.title: Technical Data Engineering Manager (CET ±2h | Remote)
jobs.excerpt: Join Cyntegrity, one of the leading clinical trial risk management technology providers in the industry.
jobs.description:
Join Cyntegrity, one of the leading clinical trial risk management technology providers in the industry. We're proud of our bespoke and highly rated MyRBQM® Portal and MyRBQM® Academy brands. If you want to join a rapidly expanding organization, have a growth mindset, and are looking for an exciting, dynamic, and pioneering position in the healthcare industry, this is a great opportunity for you.

We are looking for a Technical Data Engineering Manager to join our R&D team.

This is a technically driven role at the intersection of data engineering, clinical study delivery, and customer requirements. You will play a key role in translating business and study needs into clear technical requirements, supporting Data Engineers in delivering high-quality data workflows, troubleshooting complex data issues, and contributing to scalable data solutions across our products and clinical studies.

You will work closely with Data Engineering, Project Management, Science, Product, and R&D teams, while also participating in customer discussions and helping bridge the gap between business requirements and technical implementation.

Key Responsibilities

As a Technical Data Engineering Manager at Cyntegrity, you will:

  • Translate Requirements: Turn customer and study requirements into clear technical tasks, specifications, and acceptance criteria for Data Engineering and R&D teams.
  • Drive Data Delivery: Oversee the creation, transformation, mapping, and validation of datasets across clinical studies and platform components.
  • Support Technical Solutions: Review data flows, mapping logic, database queries, data quality, and performance, and help troubleshoot complex data issues.
  • Coordinate Across Teams: Act as a technical bridge between customers, Project Management, Data Engineering, Science, Product, and R&D.
  • Improve Data Workflows: Contribute to scalable data architecture, reusable components, validation approaches, and technical best practices.
  • Guide the Team: Support onboarding and capability development of Data Engineers, provide technical guidance, and help establish clear goals and ways of working.
  • Manage Risks & Delivery: Track technical progress, risks, dependencies, and blockers and ensure timely escalation where needed.

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or another relevant technical field.
  • Additional training or experience in data management or clinical research is a plus.

Experience

  • 2+ years of relevant professional experience in data engineering, data management, software/data development, or a related technical field.
  • Strong experience working with data pipelines, data transformation, integration, mapping, and data-quality processes.
  • Experience translating business or customer requirements into technical solutions and developer-ready tasks.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating or technically guiding engineers or other technical specialists.
  • Experience working directly with customers or external stakeholders is highly valued.

Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Good understanding of ETL/data-processing pipelines, data mapping, validation, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with data formats such as CSV, XML, JSON, SAS, and ideally clinical data standards such as CDISC.
  • Understanding of common data integration methods, including APIs, SFTP, Azure Storage, and AWS S3.
  • Scripting experience with Python, Node.js, C#, or similar is an advantage.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with an understanding of data-processing complexity and scalability.
  • Basic understanding of statistics and their application in medical research.
  • Experience with LLMs and prompt engineering.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to clearly document requirements, decisions, and technical discussions.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of clinical trials, RBQM, GCP, ICH E6/E8, and 21 CFR Part 11.
  • Experience with SaaS products or data-intensive software platforms.
  • Product management or Business Analysis experience, including requirements elicitation, user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience collaborating closely with engineering teams throughout product or study development.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Azure, AWS, DevOps, or cloud-based data architectures.
  • Experience using AI/LLM tools to support data engineering, requirements analysis, or technical workflows.

What We Offer

  • A purpose-driven mission to improve global clinical research.
  • A collaborative, international team that values flexibility, autonomy, and transparency.
  • Fully remote work setup with a results-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work at the intersection of data engineering, clinical research, SaaS technology, and AI.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

About Cyntegrity

We support sponsors and CROs with clinical trial risk management technology and related educational programs to bring therapies to market faster, safer, and more cost-effectively. Cyntegrity is a fast-growing scale-up company powered by a diverse, international team of industry experts.

Our aim is to be the leading provider of specialized cloud and SaaS solutions for ICH GCP E6(R3)-compliant risk-based quality management and clinical research. Learn more about us and our MyRBQM® Portal and MyRBQM® Academy brands at Cyntegrity.

If this position interests you and you would like to learn more, please submit your application. We would be particularly interested to hear about your experience in data engineering, translating business requirements into technical solutions, and working with complex data environments.

jobs.title: Director of Supply Chain
jobs.excerpt: We're so happy you're here!  Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

Our supply chain team has built something solid. We're looking for a Director of Supply Chain to take it over and take it further: leveling up how we negotiate with suppliers, building out demand planning and a real S&OP cadence, taking ownership of our logistics network end to end, and growing a small team as the work scales. You'll inherit something that runs, and you'll have the room to make it even better. This role reports directly into our VP of Operations.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the monthly supply plan across our network of contract manufacturers and pack-out partners, working from demand down to purchase orders
  • Take over supplier relationships directly and build a negotiation program on top of them: pricing tiers, capacity commitments, and quarterly business reviews backed by scorecards on delivery, yield, quality, and cost
  • Publish and own our fully burdened cost per unit, partner with Finance to track it, and find the levers to bring it down through smarter allocation and procurement
  • Build and run demand planning and a monthly S&OP cycle that gets Finance, Marketing, and Retail committed to one number
  • Design and de-risk our logistics and 3PL network, including routing and freight decisions that affect landed cost
  • Manage and develop your team, staying hands-on in the model while building the leadership the function needs as scope grows
  • Move our planning process off spreadsheets and onto a system built for it

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 8-12 years in CPG supply chain, with at least 3 years owning a function or a major end to end scope
  • Has run an asset-light contract manufacturing network: allocating volume across multiple co-manufacturers or co-packers, working within MOQs and capacity ceilings, and managing long lead times
  • Has a strong track record negotiating supplier agreements directly
  • Has owned a cost-per-unit or COGS number and can tell us the baseline, what they did, and the result
  • Has built a supply plan themselves in a model: net requirements, safety stock, on-hand, and open POs
  • Has run or stood up an S&OP process and gotten cross-functional teams to commit to a number, including an unpopular one

Approach to the role:

  • You see a working system as a foundation, not a finish line, and you're excited to build on top of it rather than around it
  • You stay in the model yourself and bring recommendations, not just data
  • You're decisive with incomplete information. You make the call, name the assumption you're carrying, and say what would change your mind
  • You're commercially aggressive and relationally durable: you push hard on price and still get the call answered when you need a favor six months later
  • You communicate with brevity. Whether it's Finance, the CEO, or a cross-functional partner, they get what they need and nothing extra.
  • You move with urgency and low ego, and you don't need a lot of infrastructure to get going

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $180,000-$200,000 plus incentive compensationdepending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

CapsLock is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners. We specialize in scalable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing, creative production, and technology innovation.

Our teams collaborate across marketing, IT, analytics, and media buying to build, test, and optimize high-performing funnels that help clients achieve predictable growth across industries such as Home Improvement, Health, Legal, and Insurance.

We’re looking for a Creative MarketingProducer who thinks like a researcher - someone who senses trends, understands storytelling, and knows how to turn marketing insights into videos that actually sell.

Your role is not only production, but to lead creative evolution - generating ideas, refining proven creative approaches, finding new styles, testing them, and scaling what works. You’ll work at the intersection of project management, creative, analytics, and production.

You’ll also shape and pitch creative concepts that challenge existing ad formats and explore new storytelling angles.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and document emerging video trends across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other platforms.
  • Market and Content development Research
  • Research new video styles, not just iterate on existing ones.
  • Translate insights into creative hypotheses.
  • Project management, supporting various teams from idea to delivery
  • Ensure each concept accurately reflects the client’s value proposition and target audience.
  • Coordinate creators, influencers, and bloggers.
  • Develop and manage test plans with media buyers to validate creative hypotheses.
  • Review performance data (CTR, hook rate, watch time, CPA).
  • Understand a consistent “create → test → learn → scale” workflow for ongoing creative optimization.
  • Communicating effectively between marketing, creation and testing departments.

AI & Experimentation Mindset:

You know how to experiment with AI tools - from generating references in Midjourney to using Claude to organise your workspace. We don’t expect you to know every tool, but we value a “prompt-first” mindset - when you create faster than you search.

Requirements

Essential

  • 3+ years of experience in marketing - ideally within paid social or performance marketing.
  • Solid understanding of short-form video formats and what drives performance on Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.
  • Comfortable collaborating with creators and bloggers: sourcing, briefing, and overseeing remote shoots.
  • Confident in interpreting marketing performance data.
  • Exceptional communication and organization skills - able to keep projects on track, people aligned, and expectations clear.
  • Strong attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to prioritize multiple projects effectively.
  • Fluent English - both spoken and written

Nice to Have

  • Experience in media buying or working closely with media buyers.
  • Familiarity with AI tools for generating or enhancing creative assets.
  • Video production or video marketing background.
  • Experience using UGC or influencer platforms to source and manage creators.
  • Understanding of A/B testing and how creative experiments are structured and analyzed.

Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

Job Title: Data Analyst / BI Developer

Location: South Africa

Job Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: US Hours (9am-5pm EST)

Salary: South African Rand (ZAR)

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst / BI Developer to join an established data analytics team supporting multiple healthcare and healthcare-related companies.

The primary focus of this position will be maintaining existing reports, SQL processes, data workflows and recurring reporting tasks. The successful candidate will become an important part of the day-to-day data operations, ensuring existing processes remain accurate, reliable and efficient.

As you become familiar with the systems, datasets and business processes, there will be opportunities to take on more complex development, automation, integrations and analytical projects.

We are looking for someone who is technically capable, dependable and highly detail-oriented, with the ability to take ownership of recurring tasks while independently troubleshooting issues and gradually expanding their responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

SQL & Database Support

  • Maintain and troubleshoot existing SQL queries, stored procedures and database processes.
  • Work with SQL Server and T-SQL to retrieve, manipulate and validate data.
  • Investigate data issues and discrepancies across systems.
  • Validate and reconcile information between different data sources.
  • Work with large healthcare, financial, accounting and operational datasets.
  • Independently investigate existing databases, queries and processes to understand how they work and identify issues.

Reporting & Business Intelligence

  • Build, maintain and modify reports using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and Microsoft Report Builder.
  • Maintain recurring reports and ensure they are accurate and delivered as required.
  • Troubleshoot reporting issues and investigate unexpected results.
  • Make report changes and updates based on business requirements.
  • Assist with developing new reports and analytical outputs as knowledge of the environment grows.

Data Processes & Automation

  • Handle recurring data imports, exports and routine data processes.
  • Assist with automated workflows involving SQL, Python, APIs, SFTP, CSV/Excel files and other data sources.
  • Support data integrations between internal and external systems.
  • Assist with system migrations and changes to existing data processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve or automate manual workflows.
  • Document existing processes, queries, reports and workflows to support continuity and knowledge sharing.

NetSuite & Integrations

  • Experience with NetSuite and external NetSuite integrations is required.
  • Work with NetSuite data and processes.
  • Support existing external NetSuite integrations.
  • Assist with troubleshooting and maintaining data flows between NetSuite and other systems.
  • Support changes and new integrations as required.

Requirements

  • Strong experience with SQL Server / T-SQL.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, joins, stored procedures and data transformation.
  • Experience with SSRS, Microsoft Report Builder or similar reporting tools.
  • Experience with NetSuite and external NetSuite integrations.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on data accuracy.
  • Ability to independently investigate existing reports, databases and processes.
  • Comfortable working with large and complex datasets.
  • Ability to work confidently with repetitive and detail-oriented tasks while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage recurring responsibilities reliably.
  • Ability to take ownership of tasks and follow processes through to completion.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.
  • How you present yourself professionally.
  • Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

Fraud Disclaimer: ReWorks Solutions will never request payment during recruitment or require in-person office visits. All official communication will come from a ReWorks Solutions email address. Please verify any suspicious messages with our team directly.
